2026-11-12

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-12

Overview

Chromium's main branch received 1,223 commits on 2026-11-12, of which 943 were relevant to browser embedders after filtering out Blink/V8 page-processing work and ChromeOS/Ash, Android, iOS and Linux-only changes. The day is defined less by one big flag flip than by a cluster of public-interface removals (content, base, PerformanceManager, media) plus steady security hardening, WebUI-omnibox restructuring and measurable GPU/build speedups. Day range: (102958c) → (cbf092c).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️FedCM Set-Login parsing is now synchronous. content/public/common/web_identity.h loses ParseSetLoginHeaderCallback and GetSetLoginHeaderInProcessParser(), and MaybeCreateIdentityUrlLoaderThrottle() drops its parser argument; the async deferral machinery in IdentityUrlLoaderThrottle (defer flags, parse-state, WeakPtrFactory) is gone. Any embedder supplying a blink::URLLoaderThrottleProvider (content, headless, shell) must remove the parser argument. (f52e46e)
    NetworkSecurityBrowser
  • ⚠️Renderer visibility callbacks deleted from the content API. content::RenderFrameObserver::WasShown()/WasHidden() and their blink::WebLocalFrameClient counterparts are removed in favor of blink::WebLocalFrameObserver; overrides declared with override fail to compile and overrides without it silently stop firing. Migrate to WebLocalFrameObserver and replace render_frame()->GetWebFrame() with GetWebLocalFrame(). (4ee513b)
    BrowserBlink
  • ⚠️Raw memory() accessors removed from base shared-memory mappings. ReadOnlySharedMemoryMapping::memory() and WritableSharedMemoryMapping::memory() are deleted with no deprecation window; switch to data(), GetMemoryAs<T>(), GetMemoryAsSpan<T>() or span(mapping). (90a961f)
    Base
  • ⚠️PerformanceManager PageNode timestamps replaced by state structs. GetLastVisibilityChangeTime() becomes GetVisibilityState() and GetTimeSinceLastAudibleChange() becomes GetAudibleState(); the new accessors also fix timestamps that lagged inside change observers, which mis-classified recently hidden tabs as discard-eligible. (770243c) (1dc46bd)
    PerformanceBrowser
  • ⚠️Skia YUV/color helpers removed from media/base/video_util.h. The MEDIA_EXPORTed SkColorTypeForPlane*, SkYUVAPlaneConfigForFormat() and SkYUVASubsamplingForFormat() are replaced by VideoPixelFormatSkInfo / GetSkInfoForFormat(), with a new skia::YUVBitAlignment distinguishing P010-style MSB from LSB 16-bit storage. Out-of-tree media/graphics code must migrate before rebasing. (cea52ad)
    MediaGPU
  • ⚠️image_fetcher::ImageDecoder::DecodeImage() now takes ImageData (a scoped_refptr<base::RefCountedMemory>) instead of const std::string&. A DecodeImageFromString() adapter covers string call sites, but every embedder-provided subclass, mock or fake must update its override; Start()/StartWithOptions() gained an explicit RefCountedMemory instantiation. (f7a9540)
    BrowserBase

Security & Privacy

  • Payment handler dialogs now use the invoking frame's origin. LoadURLParams::initiator_origin was populated from the top-level WebContents, so a cross-origin iframe with allow="payment" inherited the embedder's origin and could get SameSite=Strict cookies sent back after a 301 redirect. Both desktop and Android now derive it from the RenderFrameHost that invoked PaymentRequest, behind a payments feature flag. (e7b96a1)
    PaymentsSecurityPrivacy
  • WebRTC routing preferences now apply to extension renderers. Extension pages and offscreen documents previously bypassed the media-permission gate and leaked raw local IPs in ICE candidates; they now follow the same IP/UDP-port/mDNS rules as web pages (platform apps stay exempt). Kill switch EnforceWebRtcRoutingPreferencesInExtensions, admin allowlisting via WebRtcLocalIpsAllowedUrls. (588c4ea)
    WebRTCExtensionsPrivacy
  • Autofill tightens renderer trust boundaries. DispatchAutofillEvent() could pass references to DOM elements into a cross-origin document on a DomNodeId collision; it now verifies element ownership. Separately, ContentAutofillDriver::RouteToManager() drops all browser-bound IPC from error documents (with speculative-RFH-safe classification), closing a signal-spoofing path. (254762f) (949aa12)
    AutofillSecurity
  • Renderer-supplied input validated more strictly in printing and Viz. A duplicate typeface ID with data_included=true in DeserializeOopTypeface() returned a cached typeface without consuming stream bytes, desynchronizing the Skia stream over renderer-controlled shared memory — the DCHECKs become CHECKs and the print utility process now terminates. Separately, unbounded frame sinks must use viz::kBrowserClientId, so a renderer can no longer name another client's frame sink (bad Mojo message → disconnect). (b722f1f) (967751f)
    PrintingGPUSecurity

Browser UI & Behavior

  • WebUI omnibox is now hosted inside LocationBarView. OmniboxPopupViewWebUI/FullWebUI accept only a std::unique_ptr<OmniboxPopupHost>; popup hide/paint/AI-button/blur-revert logic moved into the new OmniboxPopupWebUI*Content classes and OmniboxEditModel::RevertUneditedText(), and a new flag-gated OmniboxPopupLocationBarHost embeds the full popup as a WebView sized to the location bar. Desktop popup geometry and ownership change; OmniboxPopupView::presenter() survives only temporarily. (637324f) (3e7587f) (0e41d31) (1c53dfb) (af3eb6c)
    UIBrowser
  • Tab/Shift+Tab can now reach bubbles anchored to WebUI toolbar buttons. A new AnchoredDialogRegistry backend plus tracked_element.mojom additions insert a focusable shim right after the anchor so Blink's sequential focus navigation routes into the native dialog (e.g. the permission chip prompt), handing focus back and restoring document focus on exit. (2521198)
    AccessibilityUIBrowser
  • Centralized info bar framework is now the default. kMigratedChromeForTesting, kMigratedPdf and kMigratedPageInfo flip to true, so seedless, first-run and enterprise clients use BrowserInfoBarManager instead of the legacy per-tab delegates; the legacy delegates remain but removal is promised in follow-ups. A callback bug that never exercised the migrated path is also fixed — downstreams patching the legacy flow should re-check. (4ba35e4) (8a2c28b) (c677209)
    BrowserBanner
  • Omnibox input/selection fixes. Ctrl+Enter in keyword mode no longer builds a .com URL (gated in both searchbox_mixin.ts and the popup element — note the mixin is shared outside the omnibox), fast Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter no longer commit stale matches, arrow-key select-all collapse scrolls the caret and moves past the scheme like the Views omnibox, and OmniboxView::OnFocusChanged() now propagates focus so Full-WebUI popups refresh AI Mode page actions. (45652a3) (0098f75) (3378485) (7a46f76) (d35871d)
    UIBrowser
  • New tab shortcuts and MRU behavior. Ctrl+Shift+E selects the last active tab via new IDC_SELECT_LAST_ACTIVE_TAB / kActionSelectLastActiveTab, Alt+Shift+D becomes Duplicate Tab, and GetMruTab() now skips tabs outside TabStripModel::GetFocusedGroup(). TabStripModel focus-mode entry points gained reentrancy guards that swallow re-entrant calls — relevant if you implement TabStripModelObserver. (4f2b390) (83e9d4f)
    TabsUI

Networking, Policy & Enterprise

  • DoH no longer applies search suffixes to multi-label names. With kDnsHttpsDontAppendToMultiLabelName (default enabled), DnsTransactionImpl bypasses DnsConfig::search expansion and ndots reordering for multi-label queries over AttemptMode::kHttp, matching Windows (append_to_multi_label_name = false, ndots = 1). Single-label names still expand; enterprise deployments relying on suffix expansion over DoH will now issue bare queries. (ca528f0)
    NetworkEnterprise
  • Global Privacy Control and DNT are now sent on browser-initiated prefetches. Sec-GPC: 1 and DNT are attached during phase-2 header preparation (PrefetchPrivacyHeaders, default enabled), with plumbing through browser_initiated_resource_request, navigation_request, prefetch_resource_request_utils, the service-worker loader and worker script fetcher. Headers now appear on requests that previously lacked them — audit any code that signs, replays or inspects prefetch traffic. (258b7cf)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • Enterprise/Windows behavior fixes. policy::GetNetworkName() now returns empty on Windows 11 24H2+ to avoid UI-thread hangs from synchronous WLAN queries, suppressing only the network-name field in SecOps device metadata; and kEnterpriseRealTimeUrlCheckUrlSkiplist is enabled by default so warmup URLs (and about:blank on Android) skip real-time URL lookups, cutting DNS errors for orgs using RT lookup. (1603168) (e52cdf8)
    PolicyEnterpriseWindows

Performance & Build

  • D3D12 command allocator pooling replaces per-frame allocator resets in D3D12VideoDecoderTask with a fence-tracked 2-allocator pool (rotating after 64 recorded frames, CPU-waiting only when both are in flight). Measured +4% to +15% decode throughput across H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1 in the WebCodecs 720p sample, with output bit-identical to D3D11. (f38fe1e)
    MediaGPU
  • GPU scheduling tuning. GpuImageDecodeCache::TryFlushPendingWork() flushes pending context work again but only signals busy/not-busy when real unlock or deletion work exists, keeping GpuChannelHost::VerifyFlush() from a blocking IPC on the compositor thread each frame (restores 12–35% of per-frame rendering CPU); command-buffer wait boosts are capped at kNormal with a 100 ms escalation so a renderer's readPixels() can no longer jump ahead of Viz DrawAndSwap. (f37e9a5) (494e61e)
    GPUPerformanceCompositor
  • Precompiled Python build actions. New python_binary()/python_action() in build/config/python.gni replace per-action interpreter startup for write_build_config and every Mojom action: 35.9s → 29.7s wall (−17%) and 1124s → 927s CPU across 2,486 mojom actions without __pycache__ (−3% with a warm cache). (789a8a5)
    BuildInfra

Web Platform, Extensions & User Features

  • Web app focus-existing launches now carry user activation. RenderFrameHost::NotifyUserActivation(kWebAppLaunch) fires before EnqueueLaunchParams for deliveries into an already-loaded document (focus-existing, navigation capturing, intent picker, TWA non-nav launches), so window.open() and requestFullscreen() succeed where they previously threw (WICG/web-app-launch#101, ChromeStatus 5191118118584320). Navigating launches are unchanged; killed switch WebAppLaunchHandlerUserActivation defaults on. (440c2c0)
    BrowserUI
  • chrome.windows.getAll() now returns standalone windows such as Document Picture-in-Picture, since the GetBrowserWindowInterface() null filter was dropped. The function->extension() guard in CanOperateOnWindow() is also removed, so IsVisibleToTabsAPIForExtension() is always consulted and platform-app/unrequested DevTools windows are filtered even for WebUI callers — results sets change without any signature change. (0993b1f)
    ExtensionsBrowser
  • Chrome Copy Links plus multi-URL clipboard writes on macOS. New tabs::CopyLinks() writes HTTP/HTTPS tab URLs and titles through ScopedClipboardWriter::WriteURLs() and now excludes non-web schemes (chrome://, view-source:) from that path; ClipboardMac::WriteURLs() writes one NSPasteboardItem per link so plain-text paste joins with newlines and bookmark paste reads every item. (d63250f) (9c2fb02)
    UIBrowsermacOS

2026-11-11

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-11

Overview

Chromium main received 1,196 commits on 2026-11-11, of which 946 were relevant to this digest. The range runs from (e73b8fa) to (0fba83b). The day includes several source-breaking public-interface changes, security/privacy tightenings, networking behavior fixes, desktop UI improvements, and notable performance work in tabs and session persistence.

Breaking API & Interface Changes

  • ⚠️mojo::Message parameter-struct constructors were removed. Generated bindings now preallocate the parameter struct and use MessageFragmentBase::ClaimInitialPayload(). Out-of-tree embedders with hand-written serialization, custom message construction, or vendored generated bindings must migrate or regenerate. (80d5b48)
    BaseBuild
  • ⚠️content::MediaSession gained a new pure virtual RebuildAndNotifyMediaPositionChanged(). Any embedder that implements, subclasses, or mocks content::MediaSession must add the override. Companion work enables Read Aloud progress/rate/end-of-stream reporting for desktop media notifications. (f268721) (7b55cf2)
    MediaBrowser
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::EnforceSystemAudioEchoCancellation() was deleted along with the --system-aec-enabled switch and related feature/policy remnants. Out-of-tree ContentBrowserClient subclasses declaring this virtual with override will fail to compile. (07cd5aa)
    MediaBrowser
  • ⚠️content::DigitalIdentityProvider::Get() now requires a UiWarningLevel argument, and ComputeInterstitialType() is replaced by ComputeUiWarningLevel(). Update every override, call site, content-shell/headless implementation, and test mock. (66be729)
    PrivacySecurity
  • ⚠️CookieSettingsBase::ShouldAlwaysAllowCookies() gained a net::CookieSettingOverrides parameter. Subclasses of this exported interface must widen their overrides. The same change makes privileged WebContents force-allow cookies/storage and bypass user site settings, which PWC/Glic adopters should account for. (03d01e1)
    NetworkPrivacySecurity
  • ⚠️HistoryClient gained a pure virtual CanDeferBackendInit() and deferred backend init now keys off the client rather than a global feature. Embedders implementing components/history HistoryClient must add an override; startup behavior also avoids forcing history DB init during NTP startup. (8cd36fc)
    HistoryProfiles
  • ⚠️Tab-strip observer and model APIs changed. OnTabCloseCancelled() and TabGroupedStateChanged() now use tabs::TabHandle instead of raw TabInterface*, with the index removed from the grouped-state callback. Public TabStripModel persistability helpers were also removed in favor of session_tab_group_utils. Downstream observers must be rewritten and handle stale handles. (3b0d498) (9adaf8d) (3986ec1)
    TabsUI
  • ⚠️base::i18n::GetConfiguredLocale() was removed; use base::i18n::GetDefaultIcuLocale() instead. Locale strings are now BCP 47, which can change values exposed through LocalizationUtils.getNativeUiLocale(). Raw icu::Locale::getDefault() is also being presubmit-banned outside base/i18n. (e206c25) (a25540d)
    I18nBase

Security & Privacy

  • FileChooser symlink containment is now bounded by the user's authorizing grant. The symlink walk stops at the actual granted directory rather than the renderer-supplied path, preventing uploads from following a symlink above the chosen folder. Some symlinked-folder uploads regain content; a rare prior-ancestor-grant case fails safe. (0fc0e20)
    SecurityUI
  • Web Install manifest fetches now enforce Local Network Access and renderer isolation. The fetcher supplies request_initiator and ClientSecurityState, blocks public-to-loopback/private probes at the socket layer, and rejects untrustworthy initiating origins. Cross-origin public manifest fetches still work; loopback fetches now fail. (5e32afa)
    SecurityNetworkNavigation
  • encrypted-media Permissions Policy is now enforced in the browser process. MediaInterfaceProxy::CreateCdm() rejects policy-denied frames with ReportBadMessage, closing a renderer path that could bind CreateCdm directly and persist per-StorageKey CDM state despite the policy. (339b6c4)
    SecurityMedia
  • DBSC deletion is scoped to unpartitioned, first-party data. BrowsingDataRemoverImpl no longer ORs in device-bound-session removal for partitioned or non-first-party filters, preventing third-party Clear-Site-Data from over-deleting DBSC sessions. The filter-builder interface also gains GetStorageKey() for out-of-tree implementers. (5a50e8e)
    PrivacyNetworkStorage

Networking & Storage

  • Sparse HTTP cache entries are always validated before serving a range. If a sparse entry does not fully cover the requested range, the first chunk is validated before headers are returned, ensuring a fresh network response and timestamps are stored before network body bytes are stitched in. This closes a stale-timestamp/modified-body path but adds a validation round-trip where the old shortcut existed. (76f1e9f)
    NetworkStorage
  • Native system-proxy resolution is now an opt-in ConfiguredProxyResolutionService capability, using a defaulted system_proxy_service parameter and bypassing PAC for system-origin baselines. HostCache also now reports age/original TTL on fresh hits, improving DNS staleness diagnostics. Both changes are additive. (d8f831d) (376051e)
    Network
  • Component updater downloads now stop and resume on connection-cost changes. On Windows, metered connections cancel in-flight component downloads when the component disallows metered updates, then retry after the connection is unmetered. Windows BITS/background downloads are intentionally not cancelled. (e4b44d9)
    UpdaterNetwork

Browser UI & Platform Behavior

  • Omnibox popup now handles modal dialogs, IME-click safety, and URL input semantics more consistently. The popup closes during window-modal dialogs and restores draft text/selection on close; the first mouse press after an IME commit is stabilized; and the WebUI omnibox uses URL-oriented input modes on supported states. (ad8126e) (341dace) (145e77e)
    UIBrowser
  • Reading Mode sessions survive side-panel/immersive presentation switches. Sessions are moved rather than closed and reopened, preserving Read Aloud, pending listen/translation, and omnibox attribution across transitions. Pagination duration is recorded per view mode. (3f6d0e8)
    UIBrowser
  • macOS live-resize and app-shim keyboard behavior were fixed. Tiling/live-resize stutter and AppKit clamp feedback loops are removed, center-resize drift under async live resize is corrected, and out-of-process PWA app shims now forward Cmd+KeyUp and JIS Eisu/Kana key events through shared CrApplication logic. (456f04b) (5fc7e17) (da053b0) (df734d6)
    macOSUI
  • Desktop search behavior improved. Chrome menu search now reaches items inside submenus, maps bookmark-bar and incognito synonyms, and restores the full app menu when the query clears. History hostname-suffix matching is locked in with tokenized host: queries and url.DomainIs() semantics. (52d3cc3) (8f9b004) (0b94369)
    UIHistory

Performance & Stability

  • Tab-strip handle lookups went from O(n) to O(1). RootTabCollectionNode now maintains a hash map of handles, and subtree-membership checks use Contains(). With 1,436 restored loading tabs, UpdateLoadingAnimations dropped from ~3.3 ms to ~0.30 ms per throbber tick. (e131fc7)
    TabsPerformance
  • Session files are no longer fully rewritten on every second navigation. History-bounds tracking now stores an inclusive bound with a one-step lookahead instead of forcing a rewrite after startup/restore. The change must land after the associated session-persistence safety fix. (e84055b)
    PerformanceBrowserProfiles
  • Windows drag-and-drop no longer leaks STGMEDIUM handles on every drag update. OSExchangeDataProviderWin now releases IDataObject::GetData() results on all paths, avoiding exhaustion of the 65,535 movable-handle limit after long drag sessions and preventing subsequent clipboard failures or crashes. (66b2016)
    WindowsUIPerformance
  • Windows D3D12 H.264/H.265 software screen-content encoding is substantially improved. The rate controller now uses a one-second HRD buffer, caps display-content QP at 35, and follows real frame timestamps, fixing severe blur in tab-mirroring of static pages at low bitrates. (6c5ba76)
    MediaWindowsPerformance

Developer Tooling & Build

  • ⚠️DevTools/automation surface changed. The Browser.addPrivacySandboxEnrollmentOverride CDP command was removed. ChromeDriver now bundles the BiDi mapper into content resources and honors partial Set Window Rect requests that supply only width, height, x, or y. (72a9e73) (a143c9a) (d47b405)
    DevToolsBuild
  • Build and code-health tooling tightened. checkdeps now requires whole-filename matches for specific_include_rules, raw_ptr enforcement extends to base::internal::flat_tree/flat_set, and Windows component builds can re-enable //url:url_rs_api now that Crubit supports __declspec(dllimport/dllexport) for COMPONENT_EXPORT(URL). (5325345) (6c2f862) (62df85d)
    BuildInfraWindows

2026-11-10

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-10

Overview

Chromium main-branch activity for 2026-11-10 covered 1,337 commits, with 1,117 relevant to embedders and browser projects. First commit: (67684b5). Last commit: (22b1ae8). The day includes several hard API migrations, security hardening in navigation, file-system access, and Safe Browsing, plus measurable performance and memory fixes.

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️Removed content::ReduceAcceptLanguageControllerDelegate, BrowserContext::GetReduceAcceptLanguageControllerDelegate(), and components/reduce_accept_language/ outright. Embedders that override BrowserContext for this method or link the removed GN targets must migrate or drop the overrides. (f232316)
    BrowserNetwork
  • ⚠️media::VideoFrame::GetVisibleSkYUVAInfo() and GetVisiblePlanesSkPixmaps() are removed in favor of GetVisibleSkYUVAPixmaps() / GetVisibleRGBPlanePixmap(); skia::ConvertYUVAToRGBA() now takes SkYUVAPixmaps. Update pixel readback, capture, compositing, and golden-test code. (5050876)
    Media
  • ⚠️gpu::raster::RasterInterface readback now takes a single const SkPixmap& in ReadbackARGBPixelsAsync() and ReadbackImagePixels(), removing the SkImageInfo plus row-bytes/pointer signature. Out-of-tree implementers and test fakes must migrate. (56406bd)
    GPU
  • ⚠️image_fetcher::ImageData is now scoped_refptr<base::RefCountedMemory> across ImageFetcher APIs. Failed fetches return a non-null empty buffer instead of an empty string, so existing empty() checks and string-style access must be audited. (56f4230)
    NetworkUI
  • ⚠️TabStripModelObserver::OnTabPinnedStateChanged and OnTabWillBeRemoved now take only tabs::TabHandle; the index parameter is gone with no compatibility shim. Observers must re-derive indices and handle unresolved handles explicitly. (db61849) (2bdfb75)
    TabsUI

Security & Privacy

  • Tracked-pref migration is now first-run-only. Marking an existing pref as ENFORCE_ON_LOAD outside first run deletes it from the unprotected Preferences store and resets it to default; downstream projects adding protected prefs must register a new pref and copy values through PrefService. (7b397a0)
    SecurityProfiles
  • File System Access hardening: RDP/AVD client-drive UNC paths (tsclient/client servers) are now caught by sensitive-entry checks, dot components in root paths are rejected, and incognito contexts can no longer expose a synthetic platform path into the regular profile. (d036c0a) (b5376fa) (066fc3e)
    SecurityStorage
  • Safe Browsing archive analysis no longer skips regular files named *.app inside DMGs/ZIPs/RARs/7z; only actual .app directories are skipped, closing an executable-evasion gap. (1077c26)
    Security
  • SavePackage now validates that the current RenderFrameHost still matches the requesting frame before network requests or serialized-HTML generation. This prevents a cross-site iframe navigation from causing content to be saved in the new document's security context. (1ed75c0)
    SecurityNavigation
  • Cast Remoting hardens cross-origin subframe authorization: inactive and fenced frames are rejected, sink friendly_name is stripped for cross-origin subframes, and unauthorized subframe starts can no longer preempt or disconnect an active main-frame bridge. (de51e30)
    SecurityMedia

Networking & Extensions

  • DBSC correctness fixes: key-generation cancellation aborts cleanly, session-restore callbacks unblock only their own flow, and pre-provisioned keys are deleted rather than left to GC. The per-IdP pre-provisioned key cap is replaced by a per-site signing quota. (6396070) (73e32ca) (7358df3) (07f3a95)
    NetworkSecurity
  • CrxDownloader cancellation now survives fallback URLs and successor downloaders such as BITS, Delivery Optimization, and macOS BackgroundDownloader. Cancelled attempts finish as CANCELLED unless they complete and pass SHA-256 verification. (d6b6a61)
    Updater
  • Proxy Override Rules now clear extension-controlled values when the pref becomes unmodifiable, including persisted values at startup, and dispatch a consolidated chrome.preferencesPrivate onChange. (b054393)
    ExtensionsPolicy
  • On Isolated Web App update or policy install over a user install, service worker registrations are deleted when the installation signing key is revoked, preventing a revoked version from intercepting the new version's navigations. (ef73a14) (26ffad9) (f7eb1fb)
    ExtensionsSecurityServiceWorker

Browser UI & Behavior

  • macOS history swipe is rewritten on top of NSEventPhaseChanged delta accumulation instead of trackSwipeEventWithOptions:. This fixes navigation on touchscreen Macs and avoids an AppKit callback-suppression bug. (550b8a5)
    UImacOS
  • Touchpad scroll is no longer delivered twice to Views. The redundant conversion doubled deltas and could accidentally switch tabs after a small clickpad scroll. (09434e3)
    UI
  • Tab-group and horizontal tab-strip layout crash fixed by caching minimum size alongside preferred size, invalidating on non-animated focus changes, and exiting tab-closing mode on focus transitions. Overflow-indicator rendering is also unified with z-ordering and hit-test partitioning. (a43a42b) (1d0d0f2)
    TabsUI
  • Windows taskbar pin migration now preserves the Omnibox Everywhere AUMID, fixing duplicate taskbar buttons, and chrome://default-browser-modal no longer crashes renderers when queried outside the real modal surface. (5f7162f) (7fa3f20)
    WindowsBrowserUI

Performance & Memory

  • WeakPtr code-size optimization: IsValid() becomes pure in release, operator* and operator bool() are always-inline, and operator bool() avoids a redundant null check. Measured ~52 KiB reduction in 32-bit libchrome.so. (a986a21)
    BasePerformance
  • Omnibox HistoryInfoMap moves to absl::flat_hash_map with O(1) row deletion. OnHistoryDeletions(500) is 5.14× faster, and deletion of credential-bearing URLs is now correct. (9e3f816)
    HistoryPerformance
  • GpuImageDecodeCache now notifies ContextCacheController around flushes, closing a 1 MiB GPU-memory leak exposed by startup compositor prioritization. Measured gpu:effective_size improvement is −9.49%. (6307b81)
    GPUPerformance
  • Windows ParallelPreReadFileMainDllWin is promoted to Stable at 1%, improving Chrome startup by parallelizing main DLL preread. (8e4e135)
    WindowsPerformance

Developer & Build Impact

  • The libc++ roll changes std::vector element destruction from back-to-front to front-to-back via std::destroy. Embedders relying on reverse destruction order must audit; one Chromecast destructor order was fixed in-tree. (9bdf20b)
    BuildBase
  • Build migrations: third_party/jsoncpp moves source/ → src/ (update GN/DEPS/patch paths), IDS_DOM_DISTILLER_* becomes IDS_WEB_DISTILLER_*, and third_party/libunwindstack moves to libunwindstack_tmp. (e0ec226) (3d7a126) (31b2c4d)
    Build
  • CDP V8-interrupt policy is inverted to a shared allow-list. Non-allow-listed commands on worker sessions are queued to the next yield instead of interrupting V8, changing ordering and timing for embedders driving CDP. (83076a7)
    DevTools

2026-11-09

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-09

Overview

On 2026-11-09 the main branch received 1109 commits, of which 905 were judged relevant to Windows/macOS browser embedders (ChromeOS/Ash, Linux, iOS, Android and Blink/V8 page-processing work excluded). The day is headlined by five public-API breaks — the ContentBrowserClient prerender-prefetch hook, the views::MdTextButton color-override setters, NetworkContextParams::bound_network, base::i18n::GetCanonicalLocale, and the DBSC SessionService signing-quota methods — plus a broad set of security hardening, networking correctness work, and a large wave of release-build CHECK→DCHECK rollbacks. Range: first commit (7ac45ca), last commit (544df16).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️Removed ContentBrowserClient::UsePrefetchPrerenderIntegration() from content/public/browser/content_browser_client.h along with its ChromeContentBrowserClient override, features::UsePrefetchPrerenderIntegration() and kPrefetchPrerenderIntegration (default-on since M151). Guarded branches collapse so prefetch requests are always preserved and matched ahead of prerender (LoadState::kNotStarted/kEligible now always kWait). Embedders overriding this virtual will fail to compile. (d1dea36)
    BrowserNavigation
  • ⚠️views::MdTextButton color-override API removed and consolidated. The separate SkColor + ui::ColorId field pairs for background/stroke are replaced by a single std::optional<ui::ColorVariant> each. Actual removals: Set/GetBgColorIdOverride, Set/GetStrokeColorIdOverride, SetBgColorOverrideDeprecated; use Set/GetBgColorOverride and Set/GetStrokeColorOverride. Any project building custom toolbars, bubbles, toasts or dialogs on ui/views must migrate to compile. (198ddbe)
    UIBrowser

  • Cast Remoting permission check moved to the browser process: Remoter::StartWithPermissionAlreadyGranted() is deleted from remoting.mojom so a renderer can no longer unilaterally skip the Tab Mirroring permission, with grants now issued by CastRemotingConnector::GrantPermissionForRemotePlayback(). Separately, tainted canvases (OriginClean() == false, including OffscreenCanvas placeholders) are excluded from WebElement::ImageContents() and Screen AI OCR snapshotting, closing a cross-origin pixel leak.     macOSBrowserUI

    Base

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-07

Overview

Out of 355 commits on 2026-11-07, 195 were filtered as relevant. No confirmed breaking changes to stable embedder-facing public APIs were found. First commit: (455737d); last commit: (93f28f2).

Security & Networking

  • QWAC verification is now enabled by default on desktop. The kVerifyQWACs feature default flipped and its field-trial study was removed; qualified website authentication certificates are validated by default. This is a behavioral change for enterprise/desktop TLS deployments, not an API break. (5a259c6)
    NetworkSSLEnterprise
  • Windows Mojo/ipcz pipe adoption is hardened. Transport::Deserialize() now requires the received named-pipe handle to be the sole open handle for that end, and ChannelWin matches IOCP completions to its own outstanding OVERLAPPED. This closes an IOCP packet-spoofing vector; embedders with custom Windows IPC should review assumptions. (f365a99)
    SecurityWindowsBase
  • Security fixes for libxslt and filesystem access. A reentrancy use-after-free/double-free in libxslt's direct pattern-match cache was fixed, and the File System Access sensitive-path blocklist (for example .ssh and home-directory dotfiles) is now matched case-insensitively. (61cab3f) (1138e49)
    SecurityStorage
  • Proxy implicit bypass now includes unspecified IP literals. Requests to 0.0.0.0, [::], and IPv4-mapped unspecified addresses skip PAC/manual proxy settings via kBypassProxyForUnspecifiedIpAddresses, which is enabled by default. Network embedders should verify proxy expectations for unspecified-address traffic. (1119818)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • Remoting host hardening on Windows and macOS. Windows pre-warms the LowBox AppContainer and falls back to launching without SECURITY_CAPABILITIES on resource exhaustion; macOS adds per-display capture-excluded privacy overlays; Windows curtain mode caps the RDP virtual desktop at 4K with DPI scaling. (2fbb17b) (3d99c84) (3a1c820)
    SecurityWindowsmacOS

Browser UI & Tabs

  • macOS omnibox popup fullscreen and click-focus fixes. OmniboxPopupView::OnFullscreenTransitionStarting() lets the Full WebUI popup close and reshow cleanly during fullscreen transitions, and clicks into an unfocused popup focus the input rather than activating the AI Mode button. (00011f9) (8a49ab3)
    UImacOSBrowser
  • Omnibox popup WebUI architecture refactored. New OmniboxPopupContentDelegate and optional OmniboxPopupContentSizer decouple content from presenters; OmniboxPopupUI::SetPresenterDelegate is renamed to SetSearchboxHandlerDelegate. Stated no behavior change, but out-of-tree code touching these chrome/browser/ui/views/omnibox internals must adapt. (56a4aea)
    UIBrowser
  • Other device tabs submenu now updates live. OtherDeviceTabsSubMenuModel subscribes to SessionSyncService foreign-session changes and notifies its delegate; ActionAppMenu::RebuildSubmenu() repopulates open-tab actions. (c00e304)
    UISyncBrowser
  • Omnibox WebUI popup pool now reacts to memory pressure. OmniboxPopupWebUIPool becomes a stateless MemoryConsumer and destroys idle shared WebUI popups under pressure, with new parameters for idle and moderate-pressure drops. Defaults vary by platform. (1812171)
    UIPerformance
  • Unified tab strip: animation, vertical-state crash fix, and throbber layer painting. Direct switches between focused tab groups animate horizontally; VerticalTabStripStateController is no longer accessed outside vertical orientation for tabbed PWAs/non-normal windows; throbbers can paint to a layer while animating. (65641bc) (1ad61fb) (17c3098)
    TabsUIPerformance
  • Session restore fixes cross-scheme URL rewrites. ToNavigationEntry() decodes into a temporary context and synthesizes PageState for cross-scheme entries, while Navigation API history collection stops at origin boundaries, avoiding history leaks and use-after-free risks. (6f72c7c)
    NavigationHistoryBrowser

Extensions, Policy & AI APIs

  • Subresource loader proxy IPCs get a high-priority task queue when extensions intercept requests. BrowserTaskType::kSubresourceLoaderProxy (behind kSubresourceLoaderProxyTaskQueue) binds CreateLoaderAndStart and header/receive callbacks from proxying factories to a deferred high-priority runner, preserving frame lifecycle and allowAllRequests ordering. Relevant to embedders hooking ContentBrowserClient::WillCreateURLLoaderFactory. (d24bf1f)
    ExtensionsPerformanceNetwork
  • Extension preference controllability is now explicit. PrefTransformerInterface::IsExtensionModifiable() and PrefModifiabilityObserver were added; chrome.types/chrome.privacy set() and GetLevelOfControl() now reject non-modifiable prefs such as extension-scoped ProxyOverrideRules for unaffiliated users on managed devices. (455737d)
    ExtensionsPolicyEnterprise
  • Built-in AI session API changes from context size to input size. OnDeviceSession::GetContextSizeInTokens() becomes GetInputSizeInTokens(), counting prefilled create-time context plus execution input in create-time checks, usage measurement, and per-call quota for Summarizer/Writer/Rewriter. Experimental API consumers must update. (b6a2ea9)
    AI
  • Glic adds passkey-gated opaque invoke error diagnostics. InvokeErrorDiagnosticsPasskey, SetOnErrorWithDiagnostics(), and TakeOnErrorWithDiagnostics() are explicitly documented as non-stable debugging hooks for Glic invoke failures. (a714692)
    AI

Web Apps, Payments & Notifications

  • macOS PWA notification recovery improves pre-prompt and rate limiting. WebAppNotificationRecoveryController now treats kNotDetermined macOS permission as a pre-prompt case when Chrome permission is granted, auto-open recovery bubbles are capped per app via AppShimRegistry (default 5), and new cross-path histograms were added. (3402fcb) (cd70350) (86f75f9)
    NotificationsmacOSBrowser
  • Payments and autofill flows updated. Adds cardholder-name update offers when a matched masked server card lacks a name (virtual card > name update > CVC precedence), fixes a use-after-free in MandatoryReauthBubbleControllerImpl, and enables kPaymentHandlerCameraAccessUx by default on desktop. (352e885) (e867957) (07aec8c)
    PaymentsAutofillUI

Core Platform & Developer Tooling

  • RunOrPostTask() no longer runs synchronously when the target task queue has a fence. New cross-thread fence tracking preserves sequencing; embedders with timing-sensitive task posting should re-check assumptions. (d53cdbd)
    BasePerformance
  • Update client types gain defaulted noexcept move operations. CrxUpdateItem, protocol parser structs, Updater, Ping, and UpdateCheck are movable; moved-from objects are now valid-but-unspecified. Out-of-tree update_client embedders should audit copy/move usage. (84d9f95) (feebcac)
    Updater
  • Memory coordinator stops notifying consumers during teardown. PrepareForShutdown() halts updates, post-shutdown updates become CHECK failures, and the breadcrumbs logger subscribes to MemoryPressureSource directly. (4a63341) (7287e12)
    BasePerformance
  • components/winhttp gets a leak fix and API tidy-up. SetProxy*/Receive() free prior GlobalAlloc strings, self-move is a no-op, and renames (receive→Receive, set_proxy→SetProxy, IsValid→has_proxy) plus an optional-reference SetProxyForRequest() require out-of-tree consumers to adapt. (8a4b8f4) (fe8af5f) (295379f)
    NetworkWindowsBase
  • Test utilities made more reliable. PreventCloseTestBase waits for WebAppProvider readiness and suppresses run-on-OS-login startup, accessibility tests flush WebUI toolbar pipes, and WPT runs gain --namespace for simultaneous web/WPT execution. (bbc89c5) (3996e3c) (4c16185)
    TestingUI
  • Shared-memory allocation size validation hardened. ScopedSharedMemoryPtr, transfer-cache mappings, and MappedMemoryManager now validate sizes with 32-bit overflow checks and 64-bit shrink accounting. (b385c7d)
    BaseSecurity

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-06

Overview

Chromium's main branch had 1,190 commits today, 930 relevant to embedder-facing work. The range is (d0d03a0) through (b6382b0). This digest focuses on Windows/macOS embedder APIs, networking and security, browser UI, extensions, and performance; test-only, ChromeOS/Ash, iOS/Android/Linux-only, and Blink/V8 rendering changes are largely omitted.

Breaking API and Build Contract Changes

  • ⚠️BREAKING (Windows): the exported sandbox broker contract changed: BrokerServices::Shutdown() is now pure virtual, BrokerServicesDelegate::BeforeTargetProcessCreateOnCreationThread() was removed, CreateTarget() is static, and async SpawnTargetAsync() callbacks can be cancelled after shutdown with SBOX_ERROR_UNEXPECTED_CALL or ERROR_SHUTDOWN_IN_PROGRESS. Embedders implementing BrokerServices/BrokerServicesDelegate must update. (4fa4bb6)
    SecurityWindows
  • ⚠️BREAKING: content::ReduceAcceptLanguageUtils was removed from content/public/browser, along with navigation-time reduced Accept-Language header injection. Embedders that linked this public API or depended on stable per-navigation header reduction must update code and expectations. (abd2c99)
    NetworkNavigation
  • ⚠️BREAKING: memory-pressure delivery now goes through base::MemoryPressureSource, and MemoryPressureListenerRegistry is a subscriber to it. Embedders constructing the registry must also create and own a source; listeners registered while notifications are suppressed now start at the last simulated level rather than the real one. (90b5c33)
    BasePerformance
  • ⚠️BREAKING (content embedder APIs): RenderProcessHost::SetProcessLock() now takes only a ProcessLock, with CPSP registration split into a separately ordered IncludeIsolationContext() call. RenderWidgetHost externally sourced composition methods gained replacement_range and a changed completion callback. QuotaManagerProxy methods dropped their task-runner parameters and post to the calling sequence's default runner. (50c1703) (1573cd1) (6066f5e) (50e6225)
    BrowserStorageSecurity
  • ⚠️BREAKING: gfx::Tween::ClampedFloatValueBetween() was removed, and cc::BrowserControlsAnimation::Initialize() now takes a BrowserControlsAnimation::Curve instead of gfx::Tween::Type. Code including browser-controls animation must migrate to the new curve wrapper. (b8e7abf)
    UICompositor
  • ⚠️BREAKING: blink::ExplodedPageState::referenced_files changed from std::vector<std::optional<std::u16string>> to base::flat_set<std::optional<std::u16string>>, and WriteU16StringVector() now takes a base::span. Code constructing, mutating, or iterating page-state serialization data must adapt. (17d7b17)
    NavigationHistory
  • ⚠️BREAKING (build contract): first-party Rust GN targets now assert-fail if they set crate_name. Projects building on Chromium's //build must migrate to unsafe_globally_unique_crate_name or move to an exempt third-party/internal location. (8969419)
    BuildInfra

Security and Privacy

  • Synchronous about:blank origin checks in RenderFrameHostImpl are hardened: renderer and browser origins must now match exactly, closing opaque-origin nonce reuse and opaque-to-file: precursor escalation. New exploit browser tests cover the cases; temporary carve-outs remain behind kUseSandboxTokenForOriginDerivation. (f6ac762)
    SecurityNavigation
  • File System Access now blocks */.git as a single rule and adds a ShouldBlockAccessToGitPath() allowlist: .git creation/gitfiles, config*, commondir, worktrees, info, and objects/info are denied while refs/index/objects remain accessible. Web Git clients may need to adjust workflows. (f8e7fd9)
    SecurityStorage
  • PDF content documents now commit opaque origins by default, with kPdfOpaqueOrigin retained as a kill switch, so same-origin access from embedding documents is denied. Separately, Sec-Shared-Storage-Writable and Sec-Shared-Storage-Data-Origin are no longer exempt from forbidden Sec- header checks at the network-service boundary. (9dd2110) (a1272ad)
    SecurityPDFNetwork
  • Privacy and reporting behavior changed: DIP violation reports now use the document's Reporting-Endpoints source; Universal Opt-Out eligibility updates on country/admin-area changes and day rollovers by default; and Gemini Enterprise guest URL checks now require tiered exact HTTPS hosts instead of wildcard gemini.google matches. (8490aae) (5fda4b5) (d9648ee)
    PrivacyNetworkEnterprise
  • Cross-device DigitalCredential responses now require response.digital.data to be a JSON dictionary. Non-object payloads are rejected with ProtocolError::kInvalidResponse instead of reaching Blink and tripping a CHECK. (80d0937)
    SecurityPrivacy

Networking, Enterprise, and Extensions

  • Enterprise proxy behavior is changing behind flags: kEnforceProxyAffiliationOnPlatformManagedDevices (disabled by default) restores affiliation-ID-only control for AD/MDM-managed desktops, extension proxy override rules gained affiliation enforcement, and kRateLimitProxyConfigPolls coalesces lazy proxy config polls to one per second when enabled. (42a7217) (583f376) (01c551c)
    NetworkEnterprisePolicy
  • QUIC preconnect keep-alive now carries initial_rtt and base::TimeDelta timeouts in ConnectionKeepAliveConfig, with new optional Mojo QuicKeepAliveTimeouts. This is a header-level struct/API adjustment for network embedders and reduces client PTO stalls behind kQuicPreconnectInitialRtt. (ab22723)
    NetworkPerformance
  • kAsyncDnsQuicFastFail now resumes the gating TCP job when a QUIC attempt fails after host resolution or session creation, adding delegate hooks and net-log events. A new default-disabled kPostHandshakeIpPoolingAllEndpoints can check every resolved endpoint during post-handshake QUIC/HTTP2 pooling. (c0e57ed) (21f9e3f)
    Network
  • The PDF viewer component extension moved to Manifest V3: chrome://resources is now in host_permissions, CSP uses the MV3 dictionary form, object-src is restricted to 'self', and PDF extension tests relying on chrome://webui-test must pass --allow-webui-test-in-component-extensions. (2f86c66)
    ExtensionsPDF
  • Disk-loaded component extensions now receive $i18n{} template replacement gated by ExtensionConfigProvider::ShouldReplaceI18nTemplates(). The WebUI toolbar also gains a shared extension request-access split button, with ExtensionActionInfo.id becoming an ExtensionActionId union and new flatEdge/text fields. (677d0db) (e0c4b62)
    ExtensionsUI

Browser UI and Platform Behavior

  • External URL opens now choose the most recent TYPE_NORMAL, non-delete-scheduled browser in activation order instead of starting from the last active browser of any type. This fixes URLs opening in a new window when an installed PWA or app window was last active, including on macOS. (461f8e0)
    BrowsermacOS
  • macOS PWA notification recovery is reworked: WebAppNotificationRecoveryController triggers the system-permission recovery bubble on committed navigations, tab changes, and window activation, while ContentSettingNotificationsBubbleModel re-queries the app shim's OS permission when opened and clears stale blocked state. (12591a6) (0df9c4b)
    NotificationsmacOS
  • The unified tab strip now exposes a multiselectable tablist role with 1-based accessible tab indices and set sizes. Horizontal collection layouts also keep detached compressed/pinned tabs under the cursor while dragging instead of animating to resting position until drop. (00db423) (5239429)
    TabsAccessibilityUI
  • WebUI toolbar min-width calculation now includes overflowable elements and extension buttons correctly, so many pinned actions no longer force an oversized minimum window. Drop navigation moved from BrowserControlsAdapterImpl into a WebUIToolbarDropNavigator owned by the toolbar WebView. (ad16d86) (c149b9a)
    UIExtensions

Performance and Stability

  • kWebUIOptimizeLocalResourceLoaderConfig is enabled by default: WebUI navigation commit stops deep-cloning LocalResourceLoaderConfig twice and filters V1 data sources by origin, with a reported ~14.5 ms P50 improvement in Startup.BrowserWindow.FirstPaint. (02a38ec)
    PerformanceUI
  • base::i18n::IsRTL() returns to a lock-free atomic cache with locale-change callbacks, avoiding repeated CommandLine and mutex checks that were ~50% of browser UI-thread CPU in large Views menus. One behavior note: --force-ui-direction now takes effect only after the next locale update. (fa11aa4)
    I18nPerformance
  • The Rust structured-headers FFI replaces O(N²) linear dedupe scans with an inline 16-key buffer plus HashMap, up to 153× faster on large parameter/dictionary inputs and fixing fuzzer timeouts under kStructuredHeadersInRust. (98bf4c6)
    NetworkPerformance
  • PartitionAlloc's SchedulerLoopQuarantine free path inlines random number generation, uses Lemire range reduction, and avoids a stack spill, improving free-path performance by roughly 1.4–2.8% on Windows. (5f86746)
    BasePerformance

Overview

On 2026-11-05, 1174 commits landed on the main branch (917 relevant to embedders, browser, networking, security, and developer-facing infrastructure). Notable themes include several hard removals from stable public APIs (Mojo message validation, cc/viz trilinear filtering, TabFeatures getters, pref_member.h language-tag specialization, ContentBrowserClient::GetUserBrowserContext()), a substantial Mojo serialization optimization, security hardening of protocol handlers and the browser-actuator transport, and WebUI toolbar/omnibox work on Windows and macOS. First commit: (402c14b). Last commit: (4b846a2).

Breaking Public API Changes

  • ⚠️BREAKING: Mojo C++ bindings de-virtualize message validation. AssociatedReceiverBase::Bind(), InterfaceEndpointClient's constructor and MessageDispatcher::SetValidator() now take mojo::MessageValidatorFunc (bool (*)(Message*)) instead of a std::unique_ptr<MessageReceiver> validator; MessageHeaderValidator/PassThroughFilter::Accept() become static and drop the MessageReceiver base, and generated XRequestValidator/XResponseValidator classes are no longer MessageReceiver subclasses. Golden mojom headers were regenerated. Any embedder supplying custom payload validators must rewrite; ~188 KB binary reduction. (69db748)
    BaseSecurity
  • ⚠️BREAKING: Removes trilinear-filtering plumbing from stable compositor APIs: cc::Layer::SetTrilinearFiltering()/trilinear_filtering() (CC_EXPORT), the EffectNode bit, cc::mojom::RenderSurfaceReason::kTrilinearFiltering, and the generate_mipmap field of the viz::CompositorRenderPass mojom struct with its traits. No deprecation shim; downstream layer-tree/context-provider embedders must drop usage. (3a516cc) (5b57fc6)
    CompositorGPU
  • ⚠️BREAKING: ContentBrowserClient::GetUserBrowserContext() and the content::GetUserBrowserContext() free functions now take content::WebContents& instead of RenderFrameHost&. Semantics are unchanged (the user is uniform per WebContents) but every embedder override must change its signature. (855f63b) (61694f7)
    BrowserNavigation
  • ⚠️BREAKING: TabFeatures loses its per-tab service accessors: tab_dialog_manager() is removed in favor of tabs::TabDialogManager::From(TabInterface*) and both lens_overlay_controller() overloads are removed in favor of LensOverlayController::From(TabInterface*). Public chrome/browser header removals without shims; ~20 in-tree call sites were migrated in the same CLs. (196f0bf) (dd81dd8)
    TabsUI
  • ⚠️BREAKING: content::ReduceAcceptLanguageUtils::GetLanguagesWithMaxCount() is deleted from the content public header and network::features::kReduceAcceptLanguageCount/kMaxAcceptLanguage move to language:: in components/language. Runtime Accept-Language capping behavior is unchanged. Separately, BookmarkTabHelperObserver::URLStarredChanged() (pure virtual) gains an is_bookmark_added_or_removed argument, so all observers must be updated. (785a659) (963051d)
    NetworkBookmarksI18n
  • ⚠️BREAKING: components/prefs/pref_member.h no longer declares LanguageTagPrefMember or the PrefMember<base::i18n::LanguageTag> specialization; they now live in pref_member_language_tag.h. TUs relying on transitive discovery break. Also, blink::mojom::LocalFrame.ReportContentSecurityPolicyViolation() is removed from frame.mojom (replaced by the associated OutsideContextCSPViolationReporter, FakeLocalFrame override dropped) and variations::FilterAndValidateStudies() loses its optional custom study filter. (b90a516) (db0d939) (d7773f7)
    BaseBlinkI18n

Security & Privacy

  • Protocol handler takeover hardening: ProtocolHandlerRegistry::AttemptReplace() now requires the replaced handler to be user-confirmed and owned by the same party (same extension ID, or both web), and registration without a user gesture can no longer silently replace an existing handler — closing a silent-takeover path from web content on an extension's target origin. (67269c7)
    SecurityExtensions
  • Browser-actuator/proto transport stack hardening: ProtoStreamClient sets RedirectMode::kError, enforces net::IsUrlPotentiallyTrustworthy() on endpoints/responses, tears down on framing failure; failures back off without reconnect loops; TransportServiceImpl disconnects and cancels work on sign-out/account switch with per-account OAuth cache invalidation; ipcz validates DataPipe/ObjectHeader sizes and alignment. Prevents Authorization-header leakage and cross-account data bleed. (e897980) (e0dcb39) (aeee13f) (8e4f8e9)
    SecurityNetworkAI
  • Private Verification Tokens are restricted to the active Default Search Engine (new TemplateURLService dependency with same-origin issuer checks), and the Drive resumable uploader now rejects non-HTTPS or cross-origin X-Goog-Upload-URL continuation URLs. Autofill additionally enforces context security at fill time for cards/IBANs and evaluates the last committed navigation for security-level checks. (e82db53) (22d3834) (73dae4f) (c410673)
    PrivacyNetworkAutofill
  • Enterprise/desktop security fixes: HTTP 410 DeviceNotFound no longer unenrolls a browser unless the explicit CBCM deletion error detail is present (kill-switchable kCbcmRequireErrorDetailForUnenrollment, on by default); Windows sandbox thunk allocation failure now fails the launch instead of CHECK-crashing the browser; Windows Breakpad enforces the server-side minidump type; browser crash reports now include the system-profile minidump stream via ChromeCrashUserStreams. (8842dd2) (f9d3f1b) (bbee241) (507f195)
    EnterpriseSecurityWindows

Browser UI (Windows & macOS)

  • WebUI toolbar now participates in non-client hit-testing in vertical-tab mode: app-region CSS regions are collected by ToolbarView and WebUIToolbarWebView::IsPositionInWindowCaption() enables drag, double-click-maximize and the system window menu like the native toolbar. On macOS, hover/cursor-update AppKit events no longer report HTCAPTION in draggable WebUI regions, restoring WebUI hover behavior while keeping drag-on-mouse-down. (b83de9f) (2e5e202) (f4e6319)
    UIBrowsermacOS
  • App menu use-after-free fix: synchronous accessibility notifications during row insertion into a showing ActionAppMenu could re-enter CloseMenu() and destroy the menu mid-population; a new ActionAppMenu::ScopedCloseGuard defers teardown, resets use DeleteSoon, and AppMenuSearchController is hardened against mid-rebuild closes. Also fixes HasFeaturePromoBeenDismissed() CHECK on a null user-education service in incognito. (93ea3a4) (5831101)
    UIBrowserAccessibility
  • WebUI toolbar JS split into main (webui_toolbar.js, ~599 KB) and idle-loaded lazy_load.js (~358 KB) covering the app menu, avatar, battery saver, extensions, glic, location bar, media, overflow and pinned actions — measurable startup/first-paint gains for the InitialWebUI path. Related: ContentSettingImageModel now resets BubbleWasAutoOpened when the icon hides, so auto-opening bubbles (media, geolocation, notifications) can auto-open more than once per tab. (6927442) (ce16f55)
    PerformanceUIBrowser
  • Desktop behavior changes: macOS BrowserActiveStateManager::IsActive() drops the standalone-PWA workaround that left foreground PWAs marked active indefinitely (foreground metrics/SamplingMetricsProvider no longer over-counted); Windows enables kEnableDownloadOpenWithContextMenu by default adding "Open with…" to the finished-download context menu; the Windows updater performs a unified deferred fallback from WebView2 UI to native UI on process exit, unresponsiveness, or navigation/script failure. (c2ccbcc) (4a02260) (344dc3e)
    BrowserDownloadsUpdatermacOS

Networking, Sync & Data Integrity

  • Sync/sign-in behavior change: all kReplaceSyncPromosWithSignInPromos checks are removed from components/sync/service (prefs migration, policy handler, OS-type disabling, custom-passphrase autofill, dual-storage writes), so UNO behavior is now unconditional for embedders that ran with the flag disabled. kSyncEncryptedTabContextContainer is renamed to kSyncEncryptedTabContext. (249fa1e) (a4c82b8)
    SyncProfiles
  • HTTP cache and deserialization hardening: SimpleSynchronousEntry::ScanSparseFile validates the entry header key against the sparse file key, HttpCache::Transaction clears stale response bits after restarts, page_state_serialization.cc tightens length validation with 4-byte Pickle alignment and aborts on parse error, ReadingListEntry requires HTTP(S) plus valid UTF-8, and an ffmpeg demuxer UAF around track-change seeks is fixed. (66428d1) (094a9bb) (2c4151b) (c59c2ae) (cc99499)
    NetworkStorageMedia
  • Device Bound Session Credentials deletion is made re-entrancy safe (extract-then-delete in DeleteAllSessions/GetSessionsForSite, copy iteration in ShouldDefer), fixing iterator invalidation and CHECK(deferred_reqs) crashes during proactive refresh. Sync also adds a server-controlled max_target_commit_batch_specifics_bytes per-commit byte budget and stops copying tens of thousands of storage keys before entity removal. (bd814c1) (6c219a3) (96c0b5c)
    NetworkSyncSecurity

Performance, Build & Developer Tooling

  • Large Mojo C++ serialization optimization (~492 KB smaller Chrome on Linux x64 official): new MessageFragmentBase::SetPointer/ClaimOffset, typed array element helpers, NOINLINE generated Serialize/payload(), simplified StructPtr moves and non-templated raw-handle serialization. Mojo golden files were regenerated, so embedders with checked-in generated mojom or patched mojo internals must resync. (f1bd402)
    BaseBuildPerformance
  • Compositor and layout performance: an optional ui::ContextFactory::GetCompositorTaskRunner() (additive virtual, disabled-by-default kPrioritizeCompositorTaskRunnerOnStartup) routes startup resizes to a kStartup runner, measured −34% Startup.BrowserWindow.FirstPaint; FlexLayout/BoxLayout drop per-layout heap allocations; AXTreeSerializer::client_id_map_ and LayerTreeHost maps move to absl::flat_hash_map (≈53% memory cut, 2.3× faster SerializeChanges(), but ElementIdHash consumers must switch). (b41c480) (dc5f947) (8922b97) (a5af5ed)
    PerformanceCompositorAccessibility
  • ⚠️Breaking for some C++-from-Rust consumers: the libc++ roll changes std::vector element destruction order to front-to-back via std::destroy (≈20 in-tree fixes for LIFO-dependent destructors), and Crubit enum_api_v2 changes generated spelling from Enum::MakeVariant(...) to Enum::Variant::Make(...) with forward_declare enabled for rust_api_from_cpp. Both are source-shape changes for code depending on the old ordering or generated API. (c0c2d1d) (153d9fe) (6689018)
    BuildBaseInfra
  • Build/tooling wins: ar.star builds // tables and archive headers via list join instead of O(N²) concatenation (4.1× cumulative step-time reduction, libwee8.a 313 ms → 51 ms); //content/browser is decoupled from devtools_resources removing a ~50 s serial order-only dependency; the Windows setup.exe copies --installerdata to its own temp dir so slow installs no longer lose initial preferences. (0dff02a) (43bff50) (ddb6c5f)
    BuildInfraUpdater

Extensions, Media & Other Behavior

  • Extension/organizer cleanup: the prototype-only extension UI in the Organizer panel is deleted (organizer_panel_extension_view.*, OpenForExtension/ToggleForExtension/CloseForExtension, extension_side_panel_utils) along with the never-shipped kShowExtensionsSidePanelUiInOrganizerPanel flag. Separately, chrome.tabs/chrome.windows now consistently report platform-app windows as invisible with no tabs (IsVisibleToTabsAPIForExtension false for the owning extension too). (5fb3b4c) (46f0f1b)
    ExtensionsTabs
  • Remoting Windows host: RdpSession::OnRdpClosed() and DesktopSessionWin::OnSessionAttachTimeout() now report HOST_CONFIGURATION_ERROR instead of a normal success close when loopback RDP connect or WTS session attach fails, so clients see a configuration failure. PrivacyOverlayWin is wired into Me2MeDesktopEnvironment when enable_privacy_overlay() is set. The unused remoting_console.exe target and --console mode are removed. (dd63276) (26d44fb) (6bfec3a)
    WindowsUI
  • Media fixes: the D3D12 H.264 encoder SPS now signals VUI colour-space so decoders stop assuming limited range on full-range input; BlitRGBAToYUVA() rounds and clamps destination rects for odd-sized subsampled planes so edge texels are written; Read Aloud refines sentence durations from decoded PCM (fixing playback ending 1–2 s early); ImageDecoderImpl removes requests before running callbacks, fixing a UAF. Dead MEDIA_EXPORT CoreAudio/ffmpeg accessors are removed (link break for out-of-tree callers). (e13b6e2) (d37c03f) (8f6b784) (a0a24a0) (39095d0)
    MediaGPU
  • ⚠️BREAKING for embedders touching page-state payloads: SealPayload() in chrome/browser/tab/payload_util.h returns std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> and yields nullopt on wrong key length or empty seal output. Also ClientSharedImage::ScopedMapping now takes a SharedImageMetadata in its constructor, and GetSKPixmapForPlane() accepts a defaulted optional SkImageInfo. (17aa4c9) (e0292b1)
    TabsGPUStorage

2026-11-04

Summarized by gpt-5.6-luna Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-04

Overview

Chromium main contained 1,253 commits, of which 985 were filtered as relevant to Chromium-based projects. The reviewed range runs from (41ec4b3) to (336c0a2).

Breaking APIs and Compatibility

  • ⚠️TabStripModel context-menu APIs now require tabs::TabHandle for group, window, split, and tab-update operations instead of integer tab indices. Downstream embedders using the index-based APIs must migrate to handles. (4123a75)
    TabsBrowser
  • ⚠️The public TabFeatures::page_action_controller() accessor was removed. Callers must use page_actions::PageActionController::From(tab) instead. (f887a8f)
    TabsBrowser
  • ⚠️The macOS PWA policy AdHocCodeSigningForPWAsEnabled and its kUseAdHocSigningForWebAppShims feature flag were removed. Administrators relying on the policy must remove it; ad-hoc signing is now unconditional. (6a2cf36)
    PolicymacOSBrowser
  • ⚠️Legacy memory-pressure listener registration APIs were deleted from base and Blink platform headers. Embedders must migrate to base::MemoryConsumer and base::MemoryConsumerRegistration. (34431f8)
    BaseMemoryBlink
  • ⚠️ExplodedPageState serialization is now move-oriented: copying is disabled, ExplodedFrameState::assign() was removed, and serialization helpers now consume and return StructPtr values. Embedders using the old copy or out-parameter contracts need source updates. (e279c7a)
    NavigationBlink
  • ⚠️TrustedVaultClient gained pure virtual CanEnroll() and Enroll() methods. Downstream implementations of this public abstract interface must implement the new operations. (6533c45)
    SyncSecurity
  • ⚠️Temporary blink::mojom::Manifest overloads were removed from web-app installation helpers. Code still using those overloads must migrate to blink::Manifest and Manifest::Builder types. (903519b)
    BrowserBuild

Security, Privacy, and Networking

  • Web Share file staging now removes existing path entries and creates files with FLAG_NO_FOLLOW, returning PERMISSION_DENIED on failure. This prevents symlink or hardlink targets from being truncated. (e48e0a7)
    SecurityBrowserStorage
  • Windows named Mojo IPC servers now claim the first pipe instance, verify ownership, and re-arm the next instance before releasing connections, mitigating pipe-name and DACL squatting. (2a1d1a6)
    WindowsSecurityNetwork
  • HLS data-source loading rejects HTTP-to-data: redirects, and component policy validation now requires HTTP or HTTPS schemes before applying origin checks. These changes close redirect and inner-origin policy bypasses. (a526db9) (8e254c6)
    NetworkSecurityMedia
  • Password favicon fetching can opt into blocking local and private-network addresses, including after redirects, preventing password UI requests from reaching internal hosts. (144394a)
    SecurityPasswordManagerNetwork
  • File System Access now blocks hidden files and directories directly under the user's home directory and their descendants. This default-enabled protection changes which user-selected paths web content can access. (7cdaeee)
    SecurityPrivacyStorage

Extensions, Web Apps, and Browser Behavior

  • ⚠️chrome.management.setEnabled now rejects attempts to re-enable Safe Browsing/Omaha-greylisted extensions unless the request comes from the extensions WebUI. Extensions must handle the new kCannotReEnableGreylistedError result. (017112d) (154b991)
    ExtensionsSecurityPolicy
  • chrome.tabs.move, chrome.tabs.group, and chrome.windows.create({tabId}) now reject Document Picture-in-Picture child tabs with kNotAllowedForPictureInPictureError, aligning them with existing duplicate and reload restrictions. (8cf09e8)
    ExtensionsTabsBrowser
  • Force-installed extensions that are permitted in Incognito remain enabled when Enterprise Isolated Mode replaces Incognito. User preference changes can no longer disable the policy-mandated state. (458e818)
    ExtensionsEnterprisePolicy
  • chrome.webRequest.onErrorOccurred now reports details.ip when a request reached a remote endpoint but failed before response headers. This is additive for extension observers. (c0f3b8c)
    ExtensionsNetwork
  • Document Picture-in-Picture entry points now reject recursive child activation and guard WebContents lifetime across window closure, reducing UAF and invalid nested-PiP paths. (b107527)
    BrowserSecurityMedia

Browser UI and User Experience

  • The full WebUI omnibox popup is now clipped against the organizer tray and vertical tab strip, with occlusion updates on desktop platforms; clicks inside occluding views are ignored. (e4a66d1)
    UITabsBrowser
  • WebUI omnibox drag-and-drop handling was corrected: self-drops no longer trigger searches, dropped text places the caret correctly, and toolbar drag state is cleared reliably. (691e4d6)
    UIBrowser
  • The macOS system-menu integration for Tab Groups was removed, including its context enum value and associated histogram. Embedders mirroring that menu integration or switching on the enum must remove the obsolete path. (f92ce56)
    macOSTabsUI
  • Organizer panel WebUI is now preloaded through WebUIContentsPreloadManager, improving panel-open latency while avoiding preload conflicts when the extensions panel is nested inside it. (f375c3f)
    UIPerformanceBrowser

Performance, Media, and Developer Tools

  • DevTools Page.startScreenRecording now waits until capture is usable, reports capture errors, and supports browser-window capture with validation for dimensions and frame rate. Automation clients should account for delayed completion and stricter invalid-parameter handling. (fb87847) (fd2358d)
    DevToolsMediaBrowser
  • WebSocket encoding now writes directly into the output string instead of using a temporary byte vector and copy, reducing CPU time and allocations for large DevTools and WebSocket traffic. (d9b658a)
    NetworkPerformanceDevTools
  • Common base string and command-line helpers now reserve capacity and use more efficient concatenation paths, reducing reallocations for large paths, escaped strings, and hexadecimal conversions. (07832a0)
    BasePerformance
  • Windows and macOS system proxy resolvers now shut down gracefully: pending native lookups are cancelled without callbacks, and new requests return ERR_CONTEXT_SHUT_DOWN after shutdown. (67d3e21)
    NetworkWindowsmacOS

2026-11-03

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-03

Overview

Chromium main branch activity for 2026-11-03: 1,144 commits landed, of which 877 were filtered as relevant to browser, extensions, network, security, performance and API work. The day's span runs from cb6b5d6f304d0102292271fb9a326200404063ee to db957e720f2ce6cb9ce71239e463f109feaa0bfa. The most consequential items are three true breaking changes (media copy_required removal, RunOrPostTask becoming opt-in, and WebSettings font-family setters collapsing into one enum-based API), a batch of Windows enterprise policy/trust fixes, and continued migration of chrome/browser/ui/tabs features off TabFeatures accessors onto UnownedUserData.

Breaking Changes & Public APIs

  • ⚠️Breaking: media::VideoFrameMetadata::copy_required is removed (including merge and mojom serialization), along with the media::kUseSharedImageUsageForVideoFrameCopy killswitch. Copy decisions now derive solely from SharedImageUsageSet containing SHARED_IMAGE_USAGE_DISPLAY_READ. Secondary signature changes: VideoFrameFactoryImpl drops its gpu::GpuPreferences ctor parameter and CreateVideoFrame_OnImageReady() drops bool video_frame_copy_required. (2970dc0)
    MediaGPU
  • ⚠️Breaking behavior: SequencedTaskRunner::RunOrPostTask() no longer runs tasks synchronously on an idle bound thread unless the SequenceManager is explicitly configured with Settings::Builder::SetCanRunTasksSynchronously(true) (default is now false); when enabled, a nested RunLoop outside a task now CHECKs. A companion fix uses release/acquire ordering between PostImmediateTaskImpl and ReloadEmptyWorkQueues so RunOrPostTask can't jump ahead of posted tasks. (ac3dcbe) (89ff75a)
    BasePerformance
  • ⚠️Breaking: the seven public WebSettings font-family setters (SetStandardFontFamily, SetFixedFontFamily, SetSerifFontFamily, SetSansSerifFontFamily, SetCursiveFontFamily, SetFantasyFontFamily, SetMathFontFamily) are removed and replaced by SetGenericFontFamily(GenericFontFamily, ...); GenericFontFamilySettings accessors change from Standard()/UpdateStandard() to Get()/Update(). Any embedder implementing or calling WebSettings must update. (9cbb3a4)
    BlinkFonts
  • services/cert_verifier/public/mojom collapses UpdateChromeRootStore, UpdateKeyPinsList and DisableCtEnforcement into a single UpdatePKIMetadata call (with a network_service_only mode) driven by one background read of the PKIMetadata component. In-tree callers are migrated, but anything calling the removed methods directly must move to the new entry point. (d882dac)
    NetworkSSLSecurity

Security, Enterprise & Policy

  • Windows management trustworthiness work: platform policies are reloaded when cached device-management trustworthiness changes (previously sensitive policies stayed blocked for up to 15 minutes after an Entra/AAD join), and a new synchronous blocking getter (base::AssertBlockingAllowed()) is used for the initial policy load so sensitive policies aren't wrongly blocked on first run. In the same area, WebView2-based updater UI is disabled inside elevated processes, falling back to native UI. (5ce54bf) (cc7c2b7) (861dd67)
    WindowsPolicyUpdater
  • enterprise_net::IsDeviceManaged() now treats EMM/platform-managed devices (trusted PlatformManagementService) as managed even without CBCM affiliation IDs. Consequence: user-scoped ProxyOverrideRules/ProxyProvisioningDomains are ignored by default on those devices unless the machine-scoped EnableProxyOverrideRulesForAllUsers is set — deployments relying on the old permissive path must flip the machine policy. (0afdd89)
    EnterprisePolicyNetwork
  • InsecureFormNavigationThrottle now also compares query parameters when a mixed-form GET submission redirects, closing a data-leak vector in the mixed-content form path. No API surface change. (1ebc768)
    SecurityNetworkNavigation
  • crypto::ProcessBound no longer leaves plaintext on the heap: buffers are reserved before resize and explicitly zeroed via SecureZeroBuffer in the destructor, copy and move paths. Caller signatures are unchanged. (0eb4bd8) (edec62a)
    CryptoSecurity

Browser UI & chrome/browser APIs

  • TabFeatures accessors continue to be retired in favor of ScopedUnownedUserData on tabs::TabInterface: extension_side_panel_manager() → ExtensionSidePanelManager::From(tab), permission_indicators_tab_data() → PermissionIndicatorsTabData::From(tab), autofill_bubble_manager() → BubbleManager::GetForTab(), commerce_ui_tab_helper() → CommerceUiTabHelper::From(tabs::TabInterface*) (now nullable), and site_engagement_helper() → SiteEngagementService::Helper::From(tab). All in-tree callers are migrated; out-of-tree code using the removed getters must update. (dec8add) (8d19e1d) (6cfce8a) (ce014e2) (a891ce5)
    TabsBrowser
  • Interface churn for out-of-tree implementers: SidePanelUI gains the pure virtuals OverrideContentsWidth/ResetContentsWidthOverride; sessions::TabRestoreService gains PromoteEphemeralTabGroup, UpdateSavedTabGroupId and Observer::OnEntriesModified(); and SendTabToSelfBubbleView is deleted, with bubbles deriving directly from LocationBarBubbleDelegateView, controller anchor getters returning that type and HideBubble() switching to widget close. (e750ef2) (457c845) (39d8839)
    BrowserUITabs
  • BookmarkBarUIController mojom is redesigned around raw event flags: OpenAppsPage/OpenBookmark/OpenAllInFolder(disposition) and RecordFolderOpened() become OnAppsShortcutPressed(int32), OnBookmarkPressed(int64, int32) and OnFolderPressed(NodeId, int32); ShowFolderMenu(NodeId) moves onto the observer and disposition resolution now happens in BookmarkBarUIControllerImpl via ui::DispositionFromEventFlags(). (a6377f3)
    BookmarksUIBrowser
  • Infobars can now be declared promotional: InfoBarSpec::is_promotional() / Builder::SetIsPromotional(bool). BrowserInfoBarManager centrally suppresses promotional specs while prefs::kPromotionsEnabled is off, returning nullptr/false and recording InfoBar.Centralized.SuppressedByPolicy; Pin, Default Browser, Session Restore, Startup Launch, PDF and Installer Downloader infobars opt in. Embedders registering promotional infobars must call SetIsPromotional(true) to be policy-compliant. (923696e)
    BannerPolicyBrowser
  • WebUI omnibox popup restructuring: the popup is split into four build_webui targets (Classic/AIM/Full/shared), cutting JS bundles from 762→753 KiB (Classic), 1287→933 KiB (AIM) and 1287→900 KiB (Full), and popup creation can now be deferred until first omnibox focus plus a presented frame or first open, saving memory on unfocused windows. (0fc9a9b) (22b9b78)
    UIPerformanceBrowser

Extensions, Autofill & Automation Behavior

  • ActiveTabPermissionGranter::GrantIfRequested() and ExtensionActionRunner::GrantTabPermissions() now withhold tab-specific grants (and suppress the reload-page dialog for blocked document_start/webRequest actions) while a cross-origin document is still loading and hasn't completed first visually non-empty paint or onload — observable for extensions that invoke actions right after commit. (93e7e6d)
    ExtensionsBrowser
  • kExtensionDebuggerStrictPolicyRestrictions is disabled by default, restoring per-URL IsPolicyBlockedHost checks for chrome.debugger.attach and again allowing attach when policy only blocks screenshots. (3c17d4a)
    ExtensionsDevToolsPolicy
  • Autofill's actor payment-iframe allowlisting moves from OptimizationGuide (AUTOFILL_ACTOR_IFRAME_ORIGIN_ALLOWLIST) to SafetyListManager; IsIframeUrlAllowlistedForActor disappears from AutofillOptimizationGuideDecider and GetSuggestions becomes async. Component-internal API removal, in-tree callers updated. (b808c82)
    AutofillSecurity
  • Optimization Guide fetching is now gated on google_apis::IsGoogleChromeAPIKeyUsed() instead of HasAPIKeyConfigured() in PredictionModelDownloadManager::ShouldFetchModels() and IsUserPermittedToFetchFromRemoteOptimizationGuide(). Non-official embedders supplying their own Google API key will silently stop fetching models/hints (the test override switch still works). (af7e502)
    AIBrowser
  • Headless Shell now enforces clipboard paste authorization: paste succeeds only with recent user interaction or a focused frame holding CLIPBOARD_READ_WRITE (trusted chrome:///devtools:// exempt). Automation relying on unconditional Paste in headless will now fail. (6f2e3f4)
    TestingBrowser

Networking, Content & Performance

  • CookieMonster removes a dead loop that constructed ~20k SchemefulSite objects per GetCookieList pass (multi-MiB transient allocations) and pre-reserves the result vectors, reducing allocation pressure on the hot cookie path. (cacf92d)
    NetworkPerformance
  • ModelContextHost (WebMCP) becomes navigation-associated so tool registration is ordered with the navigation lifecycle; prerendered pages can bind it and messages are no longer buffered. This is an ordering/lifecycle change to the content mojo interface. (c4c0950)
    AINavigation
  • PaintImageGenerator::GetPixels()/GetYUVAPlanes() lazy_pixel_ref and cc image IDs widen from uint32_t to uint64_t after Skia's SkImage::uniqueID() widened. Mechanical but every subclass/mock override must be updated. (4002660)
    GPUCompositor
  • ui/decoration DecorationCache::Get() now keeps uniquely-owned entries until the 16-entry eviction threshold instead of dropping all unowned entries on every miss, preventing repeated nine-patch re-rasterization of window shadows and avoiding exhaustion of cc::UIResourceManager's 256 shared-bitmap limit. (dbebe70)
    UICompositorPerformance

Base, Build & Developer Tooling

  • Additive base/ui APIs land: CTAD deduction guides for base::flat_tree (base::flat_set s(std::move(vec)), iterator-pair/from_range/initializer-list guides for flat_map, rejecting views), PrefService::SetString(std::string_view, std::string&&) plus a const char* overload to move values into base::Value, ui::GetPrimaryPointerType/GetPrimaryHoverType overloads, and base::PowerMonitor::IsPowerSaverModeEnabled() with a default-no-op PowerStateObserver::OnPowerSaverModeChange(bool). Windowless launches (--no-startup-window/--silent-launch) also skip StartupObserver::Start() to avoid the 3-minute best-effort stall. (ebd97c6) (d3c77c3) (3a785a8) (388c305) (78dd6a8)
    BaseUI
  • Toolchain rolls: libc++ moves to def01bd012f5 (99 revisions), bringing _LIBCPP_DISABLE_UNUSED_STRUCT_WARNINGS, [[nodiscard]]-style unused-variable diagnostics on container types and P3016R6 changing String::begin()/end() SFINAE (the WTF string was adjusted), so embedders using the bundled libc++ should expect recompiles and regenerated Abseil .def files. clang/rust also roll to llvmorg-24-init-17044. (606f6b9) (dda5e4e)
    BuildBase
