2026-11-01

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-01

Overview

Analyzed 36 commits from the Chromium main branch (2026-11-01), ranging from (df60081) to (d21d301). After filtering out test re-enables, protobuf roll-script plumbing, translation XTBs, histogram metadata, OWNERS updates, and other mechanical or platform-specific work, a much smaller set of consequential changes remains: a macOS File System Access symlink hardening fix, browser-UI changes in Send Tab to Self and Reading List context menus, color/theme versioning behavior, enterprise reporting debug surfaced in chrome://connectors-internals, new Cronet kill-switch HTTP flags, and performance/DevTools-affecting Blink and compositor changes. No commits in this batch remove stable, embedder-facing public APIs or change stable public signatures, so there are no confirmed major breaking changes.

Security & File System Access

  • macOS File System Access symlink hardening: CreateClonedSwapFile() in FileSystemAccessFileHandleImpl now calls base::IsLink() on both the source and the candidate <name>.crswap swap path before invoking clonefile(). Because LocalFileUtil::GetLocalFilePath() reports existing symlinks as FILE_ERROR_NOT_FOUND, a dangling .crswap symlink could be followed as the clone destination (or a source path swapped for a symlink could redirect the read). Symlinked sources now return FILE_ERROR_NOT_FOUND; symlinked swap candidates return FILE_ERROR_EXISTS so DidCloneSwapFile() advances to the next unused filename. Behavior for createWritable({keepExistingData: true}) changes only in the presence of symlinks — treat it as a security fix, not a breaking API change. (8fa41a1)
    SecurityStoragemacOS

Browser UI

  • Send Tab to Self UI handler rename: SendTabToSelfToolbarIconController is renamed to SendTabToSelfReceivingUiHandler (files moved under chrome/browser/ui/send_tab_to_self/) since the toolbar icon and bubble have been removed. DismissEntries is now a no-op, CanShowOnBrowser moved into an anonymous namespace, and unused includes/BUILD.gn deps were dropped. This only affects internal Chrome layers; components/send_tab_to_self/receiving_ui_handler.h remains the embedder-facing abstraction. (a1e1467)
    BrowserUISync
  • Reading List context menu validates URL support: RenderViewContextMenu now checks that the ReadingListModel is loaded and SupportsCurrentUrl() before appending, enabling, or executing the "Add Link to Reading List" item. Previously any valid link URL (including mailto: and javascript:) could be added, which later crashed ClientTagBasedDataTypeProcessor::Put during sync because ReadingListEntry only supports HTTP/HTTPS. This is a user-visible behavior fix (item hidden for unsupported schemes), not a public API break. (653d7ca)
    BrowserUISync
  • Color provider API and web theme version sync: ColorProviderManager::GetColorProviderFor() now takes ColorProviderKey by const& instead of by value, eliminating a copy and custom-theme refcount churn on cache hits. NativeTheme additionally increments associated_web_instance_'s system_color_version() in SetAssociatedWebInstance() and NotifyOnNativeThemeUpdatedImpl() when kThemeChangeOptimization is enabled, so web-process color caches are invalidated consistently. Signature change is source-compatible at call sites; not a breaking change per scope rules. (f7bea1a)
    UIThemesPerformance

Enterprise Reporting

  • chrome://connectors-internals shows the last uploaded signals report: ReportScheduler now caches a human-readable JSON copy of the security signals embedded in a profile report (pending_signals_json_ → last_uploaded_signals_json_ on successful upload, cleared in Stop() only when security reports are disabled), exposed through a new GetLastUploadedSignalsJson() accessor. GetSecuritySignalsInReport() gained an include_policy_summary = false defaulted parameter, and the mojom ConnectorsInternalsHandler gained a SignalsSource distinction (kLastUploadedReport vs kCollectedOnDemand) so the page no longer misleadingly reports certificates_count: 0. ReportGenerationConfig::ToString() now multi-line pretty-prints selectors. All defaulted/added API surface — no existing callers break. (e2bea00)
    EnterprisePolicySecurity

Networking & Cronet

  • Three Cronet kill-switch HTTP flags added: Cronet_disable_set_idempotency makes ExperimentalUrlRequest.Builder#setIdempotency a silent no-op (request keeps DEFAULT_IDEMPOTENCY); Cronet_disable_shared_brotli makes UrlRequest.Builder#setRawCompressionDictionary a no-op including skipping argument validation; Cronet_disable_nqe prevents NQE from being enabled in the native URLRequestContextConfig and turns all NQE accessors/listeners (getEffectiveConnectionType, getHttpRttMs, getTransportRttMs, getDownstreamThroughputKbps, configureNetworkQualityEstimatorForTesting, addRttListener, addThroughputListener, etc.) into no-ops or unknown-metric returns instead of throwing IllegalStateException. These are opt-in flags (default off), so behavior is unchanged unless explicitly enabled — flag additions are explicitly out of breaking-change scope. Cronet is Android-centric and thereby outside the Windows/macOS focus, but the flags affect the shared networking stack. (1599545) (2d864f5) (ebd5dfe)
    NetworkAndroid
  • Glic MES prewarming credential mode behind a flag: ContextualCueingService currently prewarms the Model Execution Service connection with allow_credentials=true, but ModelExecutionFetcherImpl omits credentials, so the preconnected socket lands in a different ClientSocketPool::GroupId (net::PrivacyMode) partition and is never reused. A new kGlicZeroStateSuggestionsPreconnectWithoutCredentials feature (disabled by default) experiments with allow_credentials=false. Nothing changes without the flag. (d21d301)
    NetworkAIPerformance

Performance, DevTools & Platform Internals

  • **Performance.getEntries* marked [Affects=Nothing]**: performance.getEntries(), getEntriesByType(), and getEntriesByName() in performance.idl are now annotated [Affects=Nothing]. Previously, throwOnSideEffect: true evaluations (DevTools Console eager evaluation and the AI executeJavaScript tool) aborted with EvalError: Possible side-effect in debug-evaluate on these pure readers of buffered PerformanceEntry records. This is an added annotation, not a removal or signature change. (3cbf602)
    BlinkDevToolsPerformance
  • Lock-free scroll timing shared buffer: cc/metrics/scroll_timing_buffer replaces the single 32-byte atomic_ref<ScrollTimingInfo> with per-field SharedAtomic values, guaranteeing lock-free access at compile time and avoiding process-local locking fallbacks while preserving the existing seqlock ordering/overwrite detection. Explicit padding and whole-record shared-memory assertions are removed, and Push() destructures the record so new fields must update the transport. Internal layout change only — no API surface affected. (3cad633)
    CompositorPerformance
  • Dead code removal in Blink platform/loader: removed Resource::SetCachePolicyBypassingCache(), Resource::ClearRangeRequestHeader(), Resource::HasNonDegenerateContentSize() (no overrides), ResourceRequestHead::ClearHTTPUserAgent(), and ClientHintsPreferences::CombineWith() — all verified as having no remaining callers. This deletes exported Blink platform symbols, but since nothing in the tree (including embedders) calls them it is an internal cleanup rather than a stable public API removal. (2dd5624)
    BlinkNetwork
  • FontFaceCreationType made a scoped enum: converted FontFaceCreationType to an enum class across font_cache.cc, FontFaceCreationParams, FontPlatformDataCache, and the Skia/Windows font cache backends. Explicitly no behavior change; purely compile-time hygiene. (cfecc40)
    FontsBlink

Build, Testing & Infrastructure

  • Protobuf roll tooling gains new-patch and fixup workflows: a large series of changes in //third_party/protobuf/roll_protobuf.py wires new-patch <patch> and fixup <patch> CLI subcommands, adds FixupState/fixup.json persistence, _ContinueFixupRebase conflict recovery, _IsMatchingFixupRebase/_FindUnresolvedUnmergedPaths guards (to detect markerless modify/delete and binary conflicts and unrelated rebases), in-memory git tree helpers (_ListGitTree, _ReadPatchesSubtreeBlobs, _UpdatePatchesSubtree, _ComputeCommitBootstrapDigest) and _RewritePatchFilesAlongBranch to rebuild patches/*.patch without checking out intermediate commits. GetRollStatus/AbortRoll now report and roll back paused fixup rebases, and mutating subcommands are guarded mid-rebase. Roll-tooling only; no Chromium API impact. (e0fb9dd) (117ba44) (b5764be) (972017b) (c4d103d) (8040283) (f76c096) (7754b77)
    BuildInfraTesting
  • Test re-enablements and platform test filters: ConfirmSensitiveEntryAccess_BlockChildrenNested in ChromeFileSystemAccessPermissionContextTest is re-enabled now that block-rule initialization is lazy (removing a constructor/ResetBlockPath() race); CompositedTransposedScrollEventsHorizontalComponentIsLarger in WidgetScrollViewTest is re-enabled after ScrollView::Layout/SetControlVisibility fixes; PointCoordTest.RenderTo is re-enabled on Linux/ChromeOS with ANGLE/SwANGLE and modern Mesa; and DestroySurfaceEmbedChildAfterEmbedderProcessDied is filtered out on tvOS single-process mode. All test-infrastructure only. (5e4ab1d) (c547dd9) (9e5d54c) (cc7cf7c)
    TestingStorageGPU
  • Non-functional housekeeping: XTB translation refresh from .GRD files (with an unavoidable binary-size bump), extension of Blink.DigitalIdentityRequest.* histogram expiry to 2027-12-01, autogenerated api_service_name additions to traffic annotations for translate fetches, and kjarosz@ added to //third_party/oak/OWNERS. Also, CryptAuth feature-type sets moved from base::flat_set to base::EnumSet/base::span (ChromeOS ash only, outside the focus scope, and an additive/transparent-type refactor). (663fcfa) (3cf01ca) (df60081) (7495e7d) (0955c55)

This release includes 77 analyzed commits spanning networking hardening, browser UI updates, memory and allocator throughput gains, and Windows/macOS graphics optimizations.   • Migrates developer-facing tooling: Rust GN targets should use unsafe_globally_unique_crate_name instead of crate_name, Crubit moves rs_std:: support types to rs::, and WebUI enables @webui-eslint/no-re-exports. (8230d78) (5f8b5f5) (719e7ec)
    BuildInfraUI

2026-10-27

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-27

Overview

On 2026-10-27, 1,197 commits landed on Chromium main, of which 970 were classified as relevant to embedders. Highlights include several embedder-facing breaking API changes (ContentBrowserClient::GetApplicationLocale(), SyncClient, WebWidget screen info, Blink snapshot Mojo tokens, the network isolation partition enum, and headless SwiftShader defaults), plus security hardening, networking behavior changes, and measurable performance wins. First commit: (99491af); last commit: (128ca60).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::GetApplicationLocale() now returns base::i18n::LanguageTag instead of std::string. Every override (Chrome, Android WebView, Cast, Headless, WebEngine, TestContentBrowserClient) must be updated, and callers must stringify via tag_string(). In-tree overrides and --lang/accept_language call sites were updated in the same CL, but downstream embedders need a rebuild and source changes. (bed7077)
    BrowserBase
  • ⚠️components/sync/service/sync_client.h gains a pure virtual SyncClient::ArePasskeysLocked(), and SyncService::UserActionableError gains desktop-only kPasskeysLocked plus a PasskeysLockedChanged() notifier. Embedders implementing SyncClient must add an override, and exhaustive switch statements over UserActionableError (sync UI, app menu, profile menu, password store) need new cases. (f75b354)
    SyncProfilesUI
  • ⚠️WebWidget::GetScreenInfo(), GetScreenInfos(), GetOriginalScreenInfo() and GetOriginalScreenInfos() were removed from the public Blink embedder header web_widget.h. Screen-info getters move to WebFrameWidget, and ChromeClient::GetOriginalScreenInfo() is replaced by GetOriginalDeviceScaleFactor(). Custom plugin/host widgets implementing or calling these must migrate and recompile. (aab8e04)
    BlinkUI
  • ⚠️Blink snapshot permissions were reworked: blink::mojom::ReceivedSnapshotListener is deleted, FileSystemManager::CreateSnapshotFile() now returns pending_remote<SnapshotPermissionToken>, and FileBackedBlobFactory::RegisterBlob() loses [Sync] and replaces block_on_registration with the token. Components implementing or calling these interfaces must be updated; the rework also fixes a registration race that could outlive the permission grant. (05d7b1a)
    StorageSecurity
  • ⚠️NetworkIsolationPartition::kProtectedAudienceSellerWorklet (id 1) was removed from the exported enum, and NetworkIsolationPartitionFromInt() now backs IsolationInfo::Deserialize() / NetworkAnonymizationKey::FromValue(), which reject persisted entries using the obsolete value instead of restoring them. Embedder switches over the enum break, and cached isolation data containing partition 1 is silently dropped. (2b56d0b)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • ⚠️Headless now disables the GPU by default: --headless / --headless=new pass --disable-gpu unless --enable-unsafe-swiftshader is supplied, so WebGL and WebGPU contexts return null in automation that relied on the implicit SwiftShader fallback. Update headless command lines or explicitly opt in (--enable-unsafe-swiftshader, plus --enable-unsafe-webgpu for WebGPU). (b60b30b)
    GPUWebGLWebGPU
  • ⚠️Smaller but genuine source-compatibility breaks: gfx::GetFallbackFont() now takes base::i18n::LanguageTag instead of std::string; ColorProviderUtilsCallbacks::ColorIdName() was removed from the exported ui/color/color_provider_utils.h (names now come from CSS tables); and base::Feature::default_state became the private default_state_ (use GetDefaultState()). Compile-time only, no behavior change. (7bb2a7b) (6abf312) (b9920b3)
    BaseUIFonts

Security & Privacy

  • macOS GPU process sandbox: kMacSandboxRestrictGpuDarwinUserDirs and the restrict-gpu-darwin-user-dirs sandbox parameter are removed, making Darwin user-directory and shader-cache restrictions unconditional. There is no killswitch left for embedders to disable this hardening. (794d841)
    SecuritymacOSGPU
  • Middle-click paste-and-navigate is now restricted to HTTP(S): NewTabFromClipboardURL and ExecutePasteAndGo use SchemeIsHTTPOrHTTPS() instead of IsWebSafeScheme(), so blob:, data:, file:, extension: and ws: clipboard URLs are no longer auto-opened. Behavior hardening with no API change. (eb5c738)
    SecurityNavigation
  • Hardening cluster: NTP custom background uploads now read once and write atomically via ImportantFileWriter (closing a symlink-following attack); ui_devtools enforces strict Host/Origin checks and GetSourceCode path containment; Rust Mojo runs the C++ header validator on incoming messages before C++ consumers see them; and usb-storage (0x08/0x06/0x50) was added to UsbInterfaceDetachAllowlist only for unrestricted_only callers, preserving WebUSB blocking. (ff485c3) (8020a69) (0dfbc9e) (1c9ae32)
    SecurityPrivacyUSB

Networking

  • New default-on net::kClearAuthControllersOnProxyChange (enterprise-disablable): HttpNetworkTransaction discards proxy auth controllers and non-cryptographic server auth state when the proxy chain changes mid-auth, tracks handled challenges, and fails with ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES after four proxy changes. Relevant to embedders using dynamic/PAC proxy configurations. (bedd93b)
    Network
  • Networking robustness: the Quiche roll hardens connection handling (connection ID rotation, min(1ms, SmoothedRTT) delayed-ACK floor, structured-headers bounds checks, ~920 bytes smaller TLS server params), and HostResolverCache::RestoreFromValue() now skips only the entry whose NAK fails to parse instead of discarding the whole persisted DNS cache. (789413b) (b805cf3)
    Network

Browser & UI Behavior

  • Web app same-app context-menu "open in new window" now passes WindowOpenDisposition::kNewWindow (previously kCurrentTab), and WebAppLaunchProcess::MaybeFindBrowserForLaunch() no longer reuses the current window for that disposition; single-window/prevent-close enforcement is centralized. Web App launch handlers (focus-existing / navigate-existing) should account for the new window. (b921d08)
    BrowserUI
  • Tab strip interaction fixes: middle/tertiary-button tab close no longer resizes the strip until the pointer exits; tab-group underline now animates correctly through collapse; and dragging a collapsed group header no longer selects or activates invisible member tabs, with thumbnail lookup targeting the dragged group's active tab. (71d578a) (2a631ea) (1304cb4)
    TabsUI
  • WebUI omnibox popup fixes: the searchbox now scrolls itself to start on focus loss instead of relying on a Blink blur (which never fires without page system focus), and Stage-4 Escape unconditionally reverts the edit model so a stale native selection range is not re-applied when the popup reopens. (4e78814) (266202f)
    UIBrowser
  • Enterprise/security reporting now uploads on profile open: default-enabled kUploadReportOnProfileOpen replaces the previous 24-hour wait timer (validated at 50% Stable). An observable default-behavior change for enterprise-deployed embedders and their reporting infrastructure. (e7323a2)
    EnterprisePolicy
  • Browser-verified user activation lands behind blink::features::kTrustedUserActivationTriggers: RenderWidgetHostImpl counts expected activation notifications on mouse/key down with a 30s expiry, and FrameTreeNode::VerifyUserActivation() rejects unverified renderer notifications. Adds mojom value kNotifyActivationPendingBrowserVerification; embedders with exhaustive user_activation_update_types.mojom switches should update. (f510e70)
    SecurityNavigation

Extensions

  • The new chrome.runtime.getDocumentId() extension API is relanded (flag-guarded by kApiRuntimeGetDocumentId): synchronous document-ID lookup from a WindowProxy or frame-owner element, backed by RenderFrameHost::GetDocumentToken() and a new blink::WebFrame::FromWindow(). Additive but useful for extension messaging targets; out-of-process frames are unsupported. (23d5301)
    Extensions
  • Extension robustness: chrome.windows.update(), windows.create() and tabs.create() are hardened against use-after-free when nested message loops destroy the Browser/BrowserView during fullscreen transitions (WindowController::GetWeakPtr() plus liveness checks), and <webview> guests serving webview-accessible chrome-extension:// resources no longer trigger false-positive renderer kills on runtime.sendMessage/connect (ProcessMap::IsWebViewProcessForExtension()). (1b90fe7) (2e15794)
    ExtensionsSecurity

Performance & Build

  • CollectDawnInfo() no longer creates throwaway Dawn devices per adapter (a multiple-second CrGpuMain stall); it uses GetDeviceTogglesUsed() instead. Noticeable startup/GPU-process responsiveness improvement on multi-adapter machines. (759b89c)
    GPUPerformance
  • Policy schema required-property validation drops the O(N²) flat_set insertion, fixing ASAN fuzzer timeouts on very large dictionaries. Size wins shipped the same day: ICU data pruned (~133 KB off icudtl.dat) and color-ID names derived from CSS tables (~97 KiB binary / ~43.6 KiB .data.rel.ro). (e96dd97) (ccac7d0) (6abf312)
    PerformancePolicyBase
  • Shutdown latency: cookie-store and storage-partition flushes now start at shutdown begin, overlapping persistence with window teardown on desktop instead of serializing after it. (7acd1b2)
    PerformanceStorage
  • Build tooling: //build/rust/crubit:cc_std is now private to //build/rust/crubit — downstream Rust targets using cc_std::std::... must switch to //build/rust/crubit:cpp_std; error_prone CIPD now bundles nullaway.jar and a PGO'd GraalVM error_prone native image (~1.3–1.5x faster Java builds); protobuf roll tooling gains generate/check commands. (e899d49) (2e594be) (97419a2)
    BuildInfra

2026-10-26

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-26

Overview

On 2026-10-26, **783 commits** landed on the Chromium main branch, of which **633** were relevant to embedders and web developers (first: (6f11890), last: (8b4e206)). Four confirmed breaking changes remove or restructure public content/ and media/ API surface (WebContentsDelegate::GetAIPageContent(), content::ProvisionFetcherImpl, media::AudioBuffer planar accessors, and a new pure virtual on AudioOutputDispatcher), so out-of-tree embedders will need compile-time updates. The rest of the day was dominated by browser-process crash/UAF hardening, WebUI omnibox focus fixes, DNS/QUIC and 1xx response correctness work in net/, several measurable base-layer performance wins, and build/infra changes that affect downstream GN consumers.

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️content::WebContentsDelegate::GetAIPageContent() is removed from the public content API, along with all overrides in BrowserWebContentsDelegate, TabWebContentsDelegateAndroid and headless. Embedders that override or call this virtual will fail to compile; Page.getAnnotatedPageContent is now served from embedder-side DevTools PageHandlers (Chrome's Android PageHandler is now always built, including for untrusted clients, while Page.printToPDF remains trusted-only). (17d4573)
    DevToolsBrowserAI
  • ⚠️content/public/browser/provision_fetcher_impl.h/.cc and the exported content::ProvisionFetcherImpl class are removed from the public API and moved to content/browser/media/. Embedders including the public header or instantiating the class lose that API entirely; provision_fetcher_factory.h remains public. (a9235b4)
    MediaBrowser
  • ⚠️media::AudioBuffer::channel_data() and channels() (plus PopulateChannelData() and the backing member) are deleted from the MEDIA_EXPORT header after a deprecation period. Decoder integrations reading raw per-channel pointers must migrate to planar_data(), planar_channel(), interleaved_data() or bitstream_data(). (4558926)
    Media
  • ⚠️AudioOutputDispatcher::CloseAllIdleStreams() is now a pure virtual method and AudioManager gains a new virtual void CloseIdleStreams(); BrowserMainLoop::ShutdownThreadsAndCleanUp() now closes cached idle streams before AudioManager::Shutdown(). Any embedder subclassing these MEDIA_EXPORT interfaces must add overrides. (403b19a)
    Media

Security and Privacy

  • macOS Mojo ChannelMac now requests MACH_NOTIFY_NO_SENDERS before the handshake so receive-only channels detect peer loss, and non-kernel MACH_NOTIFY_DEAD_NAME messages fall through to normal port validation instead of unconditionally disconnecting — blocking forged peer-disconnect attacks. Also fixes a MachBootstrapAcceptor::Stop() teardown race. (e137c72)
    SecuritymacOS
  • Safe Browsing Finch gating corrected so studies no longer activate prematurely (kRedWarningSurvey now checks proceed-anyway-disablement and survey enablement; kSafeBrowsingSkipRealTimeLookupIfOffline is evaluated only after NetworkChangeNotifier::IsOffline()), and the Rustified PhishingModelSetter is wired behind a new Finch flag with a safe-Rust state object and C++ Scorer shim (gated, no default behavior change). (a4fa785) (e83bbeb) (7481329) (52c5c45)
    SecurityPrivacyNetwork
  • Browser-process robustness fixes for reachable crashes: IWA DeviceServiceImpl now fails closed on non-ChromeOS instead of hitting NOTREACHED(); a use-after-free in the WebNN compiler remote idle-timeout path is fixed (set_idle_handler + remote.reset()); stale omnibox media indicators no longer CHECK when permission state is empty; a ContextualTasksUiService UAF is fixed via WeakPtr; and SerialChooserContext::GetPortInfo() returns nullptr instead of CHECK-failing on early lookups. (6258c6a) (98cd238) (9cb9660) (fbb38c2) (fcf129e)
    SecurityWebGPUUSBUI

Network Stack

  • HttpNetworkTransaction behavior change: a 1xx informational response (e.g. 103 Early Hints) followed by socket close before the final response now fails with ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED instead of surfacing a fabricated success with empty headers. Retry suppression is extended to informational responses; HasReceivedResponse() and a received_informational_response_ flag are added. (a156403)
    Network
  • DNS/QUIC correctness: DnsTaskResultsManager::UpdateEndpoints() now appends the non-SVCB fallback ServiceEndpoint whenever real addresses are available, matching HostCache::Entry::ConvertToServiceEndpoints() so intermediate results no longer delay QUIC attempts when Alt-Svc advertises h3 without an HTTPS RR. Separately, HostCache::RestoreFromListValue() skips only the malformed entry (NAK) instead of discarding the entire persisted host cache. (4257815) (06bc8d1)
    Network
  • macOS TCP source-port randomization now applies only to publicly-routable addresses by default (loopback/LAN targets are skipped). The Finch parameter was renamed kTcpPortRandomizationMacForLoopback → kTcpPortRandomizationMacForPrivateRoutes, so external field-trial configs using the old parameter name silently stop taking effect. (3093daa)
    NetworkmacOS

Browser UI, Windows and macOS

  • WebUI omnibox/location bar focus handling bundle: focus restoration forwards from WebUIToolbarWebView to WebUILocationBar::OnToolbarFocused(), stale refocus requests are cancelled, the browser widget is activated before opening menus, extension-overridden NTPs focus the location bar via WebContents::FocusLocationBarByDefault(), and Ctrl+Z no longer restores the page URL instead of empty input after a keyword search. (017ae44) (ba3a1ad) (a414469)
    UIBrowser
  • Windows platform fixes: the downloads bubble gains an "Open With..." context menu command (DownloadCommands::OPEN_WITH) backed by SHOpenWithDialog, and base::win::EnableHighDPISupport() now tests SetProcessDpiAwareness with FAILED() (HRESULT) rather than a boolean, fixing a DPI-awareness regression for embedders using that base API. (4c6375a) (47140e2)
    DownloadsWindowsBase
  • Bubble crash fixes on both desktop platforms: permission/device chooser bubbles no longer close immediately when opened from tab fullscreen (LocationBarBubbleDelegateView::OnFullscreenStateChanged() is now virtual), fixing a Windows bug where a transparent HWND blocked mouse input in the top-left corner; and BubbleFrameView::OnThemeChanged() always chains to FrameView first, fixing a macOS DCHECK crash for closed client-owned widgets. (2e6e915) (9a365a6)
    UIWindowsmacOS
  • FedCM multi-IdP active mode adds "Use a different account" and back navigation between the account chooser and IdP picker, with popup close returning to the picker. Passive and single-IdP flows are unchanged. (deefd49)
    BrowserUIPrivacy

Performance and Base Layer

  • base::SequenceCheckerImpl::CalledOnValidSequence() gains a lock-free fast path using an atomic fast_sequence_token_, avoiding lock_ acquisition on the hot DCHECK_CALLED_ON_VALID_SEQUENCE/WeakPtr dereference path (previously ~2.5–3% of browser_test CPU samples), with fallback to the locked path when lock tracking is enabled. (d0c6e7b)
    BasePerformance
  • MemoryCoordinatorPolicyManager gains SetMemoryReleaseSuppression()/ClearMemoryReleaseSuppression() with replay of dropped releases, and ConsumerFilter is renamed to ConsumerFilterRef with IsEffectivelyStateful() extracted (additive content/-internal API). Related: MemoryConsumerRegistry destruction observers moved from ObserverList to absl::flat_hash_set with new CHECK invariants, making add/remove O(1). (e596362) (a8251fa)
    BasePerformance
  • viz frame-sink video capture now delivers native-handle CopyOutputResults from the GPU-finished callback (matching mappable-image behavior), preventing consumers such as CEF OnAcceleratedPaint clients from reading dma-bufs that are still being drawn (NVIDIA implicit-fence issue). (3cd7aa2)
    GPUCompositor
  • PartitionAlloc's ConfigurablePool can now be configured with a memory protection key (pkey) and enforces it on all pool memory; gin/v8_initializer.cc passes the V8 sandbox's active pkey so pages freed via UnreserveAndDecommit don't lose permissions and trigger PKU faults. Additive API, fixes a crash class on Windows/macOS. (0b629d1) (c8b5d92)
    BaseV8

Developer-Facing APIs, DevTools and Build

  • The DevTools /remote/ path in DevToolsDataSource is now restricted to devtools://devtools-remote only, following the devtools-frontend getRemoteBase() change. Any embedder serving remote-frontend bundles from a different origin will break. (184da0e)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • browser_events.proto (synced enterprise security-event schema) adds BrowserFeatureInfo/FEATURE_TYPE_DEVTOOLS_UI and removes TRANSPORT_TYPE_DEVTOOLS_UI from ExternalProcessInfo.TransportType (field 3 reserved). Out-of-tree consumers parsing the old enum value must update. (a79cfe8)
    EnterprisePolicy
  • Build plumbing for downstream embedders: check_includes_strict migrates to the global check_includes_strict_exceptions list (per-target overrides dropped from ~45 BUILD.gn files, BUILDCONFIG.gn no longer auto-applies the allowlist), and proto_library import_dirs become build-directory independent by mapping root_gen_dir to gen, fixing fuzzer GN targets and stabilizing compiler command lines. (7884a0f) (72b309b)
    BuildInfra

Web Platform and Media

  • WebGL-on-WebGPU correctness: OnContextLost() is now called before freeing gles2_for_objects_ (fixing a dangling-pointer crash on context GC), and rendering switches to GL_ANGLE_explicit_context entry points (including glDepthRangef). (29ed367) (9c6aa13)
    WebGLWebGPUGPU
  • media::VideoEncoderOutput gains an additive std::optional<double> qp (normalized 0–1) populated by the VPX/AV1/OpenH264 encoders and VideoEncodeAcceleratorAdapter; Cast uses it for frame lossiness. Positional aggregate initialization of the struct needs updating. Relatedly, the Remoting VPX encoder now defaults rc_min_quantizer=10/rc_max_quantizer=50 to match WebRTC wrappers. (09e1663) (1a09783)
    MediaWebRTC
  • kPaymentRequestRejectTooSmallWindows is returned to disabled by default as an emergency killswitch, restoring PaymentRequest.show() behavior that the 5% dialog-headroom check was incorrectly rejecting in maximized windows. (30dc3b3)
    PaymentsUI

2026-10-25

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-25

Overview

This digest covers 27 commits between (c71b0c8) and (231082c) (~main@{#(1726678)} .. main@{#(1726572)}). The majority were iOS/Android-only test re-enables, field-trial config edits, and mechanical refactors outside the scope of desktop (Windows/macOS) embedders. After filtering, the notable changes concern Safe Browsing navigation-priority plumbing, new content-layer site sharding support, WebAudio/media fixes, discard-driven fast shutdown, Autofill IBAN regex patterns, an experimental Smart Card API addition, and test-infrastructure tuning. No confirmed MAJOR breaking changes to stable public APIs were found; the WebAudioBus::ChannelData spanification is a source-level type change for a Blink public header but falls under the span-migration guidance and is not treated as breaking here.

Security & Navigation

  • Safe Browsing check replies for synchronous, non-prefetch navigation hash-database lookups can now be posted on BrowserTaskType::kNavigationNetworkResponse instead of the congested default UI queue, so navigations deferred in WillProcessResponse waiting on sync_sb_checker_ are no longer starved. Plumbed via Client::GetCustomCallbackTaskRunner() through DatabaseManagerMechanism into SBDatabase::GetStoresMatchingFullHash; async checks, real-time checks, and prefetch requests stay on the default queue. Gated behind safe_browsing::kPrioritizeSafeBrowsingNavigationCallbacks; Android's remote database manager follows separately. (112bbb5)
    SecurityNetworkPerformance
  • Site scoping change for error pages when shards are configured: with shards enabled, error pages for blocked renderer-initiated requests commit in the destination's process (NavigationRequest::ComputeErrorPageProcess()) rather than the current one, so a process never hosts content from another shard. Default configuration (no shards) is unchanged. (bfa7a4c)
    NavigationSecurityBrowser

Content API & Multi-Process Architecture

  • New embedder-facing sharding support for default SiteInstances (WebView Site Sharding): adds SiteShard (kDefault, kEmbedderSites), BrowserContext::SetSitesForEmbedderShard() (call-once, HTTP(S)-only, CHECK-guarded against default SiteInstanceGroups / single-process / Rust CPSP), SiteInfo::shard() folded into SiteInfo equality and ProcessLock comparison, one default SiteInstance per shard per BrowsingInstance, and ProcessLock::SetIsUsed() shard pinning. RenderProcessHostImpl::IsSuitableHost() and Citadel checks prevent cross-shard process reuse. Purely additive for embedders that never call the new API (shard computation is skipped when no shards exist), but it touches core SiteInfo/ProcessLock construction signatures — embedders constructing SiteInfo by hand must add the shard argument. (bfa7a4c)
    NavigationSecurityBrowser

Media & Web Audio

  • WebAudio native-sample-rate fix: AudioBus::CreateBusFromInMemoryAudioFile() now honors the documented sample_rate == 0.0f contract by decoding at the file's native rate instead of passing 0.0f into TryCreateBySampleRateConverting() (which previously divided by zero and returned a 0-frame bus). TryCreateBySampleRateConverting() now validates the target rate and returns nullptr for invalid/negative values. Alongside this, blink::WebAudioBus::ChannelData() changed from float* ChannelData(unsigned) to base::span<float> (with CHECK_LT bounds enforcement) — a source-level signature change in a Blink public platform header, though a mechanical span migration. (d2aed4c)
    MediaBlink
  • Rust demuxer metadata parsing enabled: turns on symphonia's all-meta feature so container readers (MP3/ID3v2) parse embedded metadata tags during probing and demuxing; only generated BUILD.gn feature flags change. Separately, Media Router upgraded remaining Remote Playback codec DCHECKs in MediaRouterUI/MediaRouteStarter to CHECK, enforcing the existing MediaNotificationService codec-filter precondition (crash instead of silent bad state on violated invariants). (592e07e) (2144f13)
    MediaBrowser

Browser Lifecycle & Performance

  • Discarded-frame Stage 2 shutdown now ignores workers: RenderFrameHostImpl::DiscardFrame()'s reply callback passes ignore_workers=true to FastShutdownIfPossible(), matching DiscardedRFHProcessHelper::ShutdownIfPossible(), so a discarded renderer holding worker refs can still be reclaimed. Tests were moved from IncrementWorkerRefCount() to IncrementPendingReuseRefCount(), MockRenderProcessHost::FastShutdownIfPossible() now respects ignore_workers, and FastShutdownExitObserver was refactored onto base::ScopedObservation. (2c4a157)
    PerformanceBrowserTesting

Autofill & Payments

  • IBAN form-detection patterns rolled and corrected: rolls components/autofill/.../internal_resources to pick up new IT/FR/ES/PL IBAN_VALUE patterns (only consumed by enable_src_internal Google Chrome builds, gated by AutofillEnableExpandIbanRegexPattern), and fixes the legacy Spanish pattern which matched plural "número de cuentas" and missed the common singular "Número de cuenta". Expect improved IBAN field classification on localized forms. (873d043)
    AutofillPayments

Web Platform APIs (Experimental) & Build Flags

  • Experimental SmartCardContext.release(): adds the Blink IDL binding plus a use counter behind the new SmartCardContextRelease runtime-enabled feature and matching chrome://flags entry. The method is a stub that always rejects with NotSupportedError until the implementation lands; no stable-surface change. (bd0c800) (ce6c06c)
    BlinkSecurityBuild
  • ENABLE_SMART_CARD raw define converted to a buildflag in //third_party/blink/public:buildflags (BUILDFLAG(ENABLE_SMART_CARD)), with consumers in //content/browser DevTools and isolated-web-app entitlement tests migrated. Fixes the define never reaching isolated_web_app_entitlements_browsertest.cc; out-of-tree build files still using #ifdef ENABLE_SMART_CARD will silently compile the code out. (c61e200)
    BuildBlinkSecurity

Testing & Infrastructure

  • Field-trial test config reshaped: translate studies TranslateShortTextStaticContext/TranslateAsyncDomTranslator were consolidated into a single TranslateElementFeatures study exercising TranslateElementExperimentFeatures (ef=ests,eadt), and SimplifiedHindiModel was dropped from the config — affecting only fieldtrial_testing_config.json, not shipped behavior. (b40840e) (445ead6)
    TestingInfra
  • Android browser-test runtime trimming: adds android.phone.android_browsertests.filter excluding the two tablet-only side-panel suites on phone CQ/CI builders (removing ~95 no-op Activity launches), and aligns AndroidBrowserTest with InProcessBrowserTest by disabling search preconnect/prewarm, kRestartNetworkServiceUnsandboxedForFailedLaunch, kTransientKeepAlivePolicy, and IPH features by default. Test-only behavior; embedded test harnesses relying on those defaults must enable them explicitly. (5009d53) (231082c)
    TestingAndroidPerformance

Blink Rendering Fixes (informational)

  • ::first-letter no longer skews paragraph boundaries in white-space-preserving text: StartOfParagraphAlgorithm()/EndOfParagraphAlgorithm() now convert between DOM offsets and LayoutTextFragment fragment indices instead of using DOM offsets directly, and a test expectation that recorded the wrong EndOfParagraph() result was corrected. Also, the GC-deferred CalculationValue handle-decrement change in ~Length() was reverted after a crash regression, restoring the original length.cc behavior. (c71b0c8) (600f90b)
    BlinkPerformance

2026-10-24

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-24

Overview

A total of 46 commits were analyzed spanning revisions (e55752e) to (695e487). The changes focus primarily on browser UI stability, Windows accessibility fixes, enterprise clipboard auditing, network API optimizations, and security hardening for PDF navigations. No major breaking changes to public embedder APIs were identified.

Security & Enterprise Protection

  • Disallowed creating Service Worker main-resource handles for PDF navigations as a defense-in-depth measure, preventing PDF renderer processes from receiving Service Worker-intercepted subresource responses or gaining storage access to the hosting origin. (f8cc87d)
  • Updated enterprise Data Controls clipboard enforcement to trigger DLP content analysis even when clipboard text is replaced, ensuring managed environments still audit and enforce policies for data restricted to the browser. (b09fb88)
  • Updated static preloaded HSTS entries across the global transport security preload database. (2e8c19f)

Browser UI & Navigation

  • Fixed an infinite loop and browser hang in dynamic bookmark menus caused by repeated additions and removals of observers when loading bookmarks while the application menu was active. (19aeeb8)
  • Refined infobar priority queuing to prevent lower-priority replacement bars from displacing queued higher-priority bars, and suppressed queued-count indicator pills on persistent, non-closeable infobars. (2918066) (7ac45f4)
  • Fixed an issue in the WebUI Omnibox popup where cutting a selection from previewed match text erroneously erased the full input row, preserving proper editing and undo history. (695e487)
  • Scoped Contextual Tasks side panel thread modifications and thread creations to individual active tabs, and enabled side panel thread state to persist across tab closures for recovery via TabRestoreService. (1e37553) (8a5b2f0) (b01d831) (dbe5983)
  • Addressed Tab Organizer panel UI issues by correcting child view hit-testing when open, auto-closing section menus on loss of focus, and preserving tab group last-update timestamps during session restore. (e55752e) (3a7361d) (5fcaee8)

Accessibility & Platform Integration

  • Prevented browser crashes caused by synchronous COM re-entrancy during Windows accessibility event dispatch by securing object references and validating manager/node/frame host liveness. (a752502)
  • Optimized Windows UI Automation (UIA) attribute queries by skipping expensive coordinate translations for attributes that do not depend on text offsets (such as IsReadOnly), resolving UI thread freezes during focus tracking. (a96815e)

Networking & Embedder APIs

  • Modernized public Content Security Policy parsing utilities in services/network/public/cpp with std::string_view, heterogeneous base::flat_set lookups, and a new ToStringView(mojom::CSPDirectiveName) helper to eliminate unnecessary string copies. (d4c1323)
  • Updated blink.mojom.ManifestManager Mojo interfaces to support nullable Manifest? responses while maintaining backward compatibility with existing browser-side callers via ManifestManagerHost fallbacks. (277bebc)

Performance & Testing Utilities

  • Eliminated heap allocations during complex text shaping by adopting absl::InlinedVector for script extensions in RenderTextHarfBuzz. (ae6aa9e)
  • Excluded compositor PaintOpBuffer destruction, resets, and scratch vector resizing from PartitionAlloc safety check quarantining, significantly cutting deallocation overhead and memory churn. (7028282) (0e95ec7)
  • Introduced a DestroyBrowserContext() virtual teardown hook in content::RenderViewHostTestHarness to allow custom test contexts to be cleanly destroyed before test environment shutdown. (2521b65)

2026-10-23

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-23

Overview

On 2026-10-23, Chromium's main branch received 1,046 commits, of which 834 were relevant to this digest after filtering out ChromeOS/Ash, iOS, Android-only, and Blink/V8 rendering internals. The day was headlined by three breaking public-API changes (viz overlay metadata removal, ui::TreeModel/TreeNodeModel restructuring, and a WebTransport send-stats mojom redesign), alongside a substantial batch of security hardening in File System Access, touch drag handling, and extension capture, plus measurable performance work in base::FeatureList, the omnibox, and macOS display handling. First commit: (b338778); last commit: (fc9710f).

Breaking Public API Changes

  • ⚠️BREAKING: Removes TransferableResource::MetadataOverride::is_overlay_candidate from the exported viz struct (components/viz/common/resources/transferable_resource.h) and the matching field from transferable_resource.mojom, including its StructTraits accessor and deserialization. GetIsOverlayCandidate() now derives only from SHARED_IMAGE_USAGE_SCANOUT on the backing SharedImage. Embedders constructing the mojom struct or setting the hint will fail to compile or silently lose overlay hints. (32b45ee)
    CompositorGPU
  • ⚠️BREAKING: Deletes ui::TreeNodeModel<T> and detaches standalone ui::TreeNode<T> from ui::TreeModelNode; TreeModel::GetRoot/GetChildren/GetIndexOf/GetParent and TreeModelNode title/accessibility accessors become non-virtual; the protected TreeModel() constructor is removed so models require an explicit unique_ptr<TreeModelNode> root. Any embedder subclass deriving from TreeNodeModel or overriding these accessors breaks (or silently stops being called). (3be49d7)
    UIBrowser
  • ⚠️BREAKING: WebTransport::GetSendStreamStats(uint32) is replaced by a batched GetSendStreamStats(array<uint32>) => (array<WebTransportSendStreamStats?>), WebTransportClient gains a required OnOutgoingStreamStatsFinalized(...), and WebTransport::UnregisterSendStream() is removed. Send-group getStats() now reports real aggregated counters instead of zeroes; custom network-service or WebTransport client implementations must be updated. (4cc5073)
    Network

Security & Privacy

  • File System Access handle serialization now takes the caller's blink::StorageKey, records the owning origin in LocalFileData, and verifies it on deserialize, plus transfer-token validation during serialize. Closes a cross-origin token escalation where a compromised renderer could persist a foreign token into its own IndexedDB bucket. (71ea1e9)
    StorageSecurity
  • File System Access now rejects Windows hypervisor UNC share roots, sensitive host directories, and shell startup dotfiles, hardening the picker against dangerous file grants. No API change, but embedders relying on broad path access will observe new denials. (bc29f45)
    StorageSecurityWindows
  • Relands touch-drag hardening: adds additive aura::Env::ConsumeTouchForDrag(window) with per-window ActiveTouch tracking so renderer-initiated drags must correspond to a touch pressed on the WebContents itself, and each press can start at most one drag. Fixes synthetic-drag spoofing from other windows; content that latched drags onto unrelated touches will now be rejected. (0552262)
    UISecurity
  • Credential UI now sanitizes site-supplied usernames and display names via GetSingleLineDisplayText(), collapsing control characters, newlines, whitespace runs, and unterminated bidi controls in the account chooser, federated save bubble, and auto sign-in bubble — closing a UI-spoofing vector. (71b45ec)
    PasswordManagerSecurity
  • Extensions tab-capture tightening: tabCapture.getMediaStreamId() now passes include_incognito_information() when resolving tabs (fixing an incognito-access leak), and TabCaptureRegistry::CanCaptureWebContents() rejects chrome:// pages on navigation, so an active capture session stops when the captured tab navigates to a chrome:// URL (component/command-line allowlisted extensions exempt). (851a6a2) (2665b0b)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • base::Pickle invariants are promoted from DCHECK to CHECK: writing to a WithUnownedBuffer() pickle, out-of-range header_size, and Reserve()/claim exceeding 4 GB now fail in release builds instead of corrupting memory. Correct callers are unaffected; misuse now crashes deterministically. (439c14a)
    Base

Networking, Enterprise & Policy

  • network::mojom::NetworkContext gains two new pure-virtual methods: GetProxySettings() (surfaced in chrome://net-internals with original/effective proxy config and the cached bad-proxy list) and Clone(PendingReceiver<NetworkContext>) (cloned receivers live in a separate ReceiverSet, enabling off-UI-thread preconnect/QUIC via CrossThreadNetworkContext). Additive to the protocol, but embedders implementing NetworkContext (test doubles, custom network services) must add overrides. (bd7264f) (e6a8723)
    Network
  • Adds default-implemented ContentBrowserClient::GetInitialInsecureDnsMode() (returns kDisabled) plus NetworkServiceParams::initial_insecure_dns_mode so the stub host resolver is created with the right mode at service init; WebView opts in. Existing embedders continue to compile unchanged. (3de3a50)
    Network
  • WebAppUrlLoader now requires kUrlLoaded to be a committed cross-document navigation whose committed URL still matches, plus a same-origin check on manifest_id in ExternalAppResolutionCommand — fixing a shared-background-WebContents origin-confusion issue. Note the error-classification shift: non-committing responses (204/205/downloads) now report kFailedUnknownReason/kInstallURLLoadFailed rather than timeout errors, so callers matching on those codes should update. (6c67a1f)
    NavigationSecurity
  • Enterprise/SSL updates: managed client certificates can use the sanitized device hostname as Subject CN (common_name_source, behind kClientCertCommonNameAttribute) with renewal triggering, and Secure Gateway defaults flip kEnableDynamicRouteFetching/kEnterpriseProxyErrorHandling on while remaining kill switches. A new ENTERPRISE_PROXY PolicyLogger source adds enterprise proxy diagnostics. (b916210) (f93347c) (44ea4b6)
    EnterpriseSSLPolicy
  • HTTP cache now fails 206 responses whose body length does not match their own Content-Range (leniency removal for malformed servers), and MHTML classification is made case-insensitive per RFC 2045 for NavigationRequest::IsMhtmlMimeType()/download_utils::MustDownload(), so Multipart/Related/Message/RFC822 variants no longer fall through to download or render paths. (baeba81) (e8322aa)
    NetworkNavigation

Browser UI, WebUI & DevTools

  • The WebUI omnibox popup now hides with the location bar in fullscreen (LocationBarView::VisibilityChanged() closes it and moves focus to the page), with a new virtual OmniboxPopupView::ReshowPopup() to reopen a surviving draft on exit and OmniboxEditModel::HasDraft() to end unfocused drafts on navigation. Excludes macOS/ChromeOS immersive and the WebUI toolbar variant. (d6c5238)
    BrowserUI
  • macOS: WebContentsOcclusionCheckerMac + NativeWidgetMacNSWindowHost now hide the Views compositor when a window is occluded so Viz releases buffers (new ui::views feature), and ExternalBeginFrameSourceMac avoids the slow CGDisplayModeGetRefreshRate() path when CADisplayLink is active. Occluded windows/surfaces should show lower memory and GPU usage. (d694c16) (94e30b1)
    macOSCompositor
  • Windows: SetWindowDisplayAffinity() is only called when the affinity actually changes and is skipped for hidden owned windows, fixing DWM blank/white-box artifacts caused by third-party overlays on captured or overlaid windows. (ccdfaa6)
    WindowsUI
  • DevTools behavior changes: Target/Browser//json/new return protocol errors instead of CHECK/DCHECK/null-Profile dereferences when the last-used profile can't be loaded; save dialogs preserve bare filenames by passing the URL as suggested_name and honoring FinalExtension() (so .json.gz traces survive macOS UTType); and Page.captureScreenshot/HeadlessExperimental.beginFrame pick the libwebp method from optimizeForSpeed, changing WebP output bytes (relevant to Puppeteer/Playwright artifact comparisons). (ee558d4) (b647abf) (17a8be6)
    DevTools
  • Settings WebUI modernization: SettingsBooleanControlMixin, settings-checkbox, and settings-toggle-button migrate from Polymer to Lit (CSS/HTML templates restructured). Front-end only, but embedder WebUI extending these controls or relying on Polymer internals (this.$.id, notify: true) needs updating. WebuiRoundedIcons also flips on by default for toolbar/WebUI icons. (a57ffb5) (c11ad00)
    UI

Performance & Memory

  • base::FeatureList now caches the resolved enabled state instead of the raw OverrideState (new kCachedResolvedEnabledMask/kCachedExplicitOverrideMask bits, fallback resolution moved into a NOINLINE FeatureList::ResolveFeatureEnabledState()), taking lookups from ~10.92 ns to ~4.10 ns. Public IsEnabled()/GetOverrideState() semantics are unchanged; only base::internal bit masks changed, so code poking cached_value directly must be updated. (df3a810)
    BasePerformance
  • AutocompleteResult no longer pre-reserves ~30 AutocompleteMatch slots, saving roughly 50 kB per instance and ~250 kB per desktop window (two controllers × two results plus the SearchboxHandler snapshot) with no intended behavior change. (14a0a49)
    BrowserPerformance
  • macOS display-link robustness: kUseDisplayRefreshRateForTimer is default-on so the BeginFrameSource timer matches the display's actual refresh rate when DisplayLinkMac creation fails, and CADisplayLink failures fall back to CVDisplayLink instead of a 60 Hz timer. Frame cadence may differ on machines with flaky display-link support. (c254fd1) (de1036a)
    macOSCompositorPerformance
  • Windows Media Foundation playback sets MF_MEDIA_ENGINE_AUDIOONLY and skips DirectComposition setup when the resource has audio but no video (low-latency mode preserved), removing unnecessary GPU/video work for audio-only media. (05ee29c)
    MediaWindows

Build & Developer Tooling

  • Build-surface removals that break out-of-tree GN users: //third_party/khronos and its header tree are deleted (includes migrated to //third_party/angle/include), and the obsolete rtc_link_task_queue_impl/rtc_include_ilbc GN default args are removed from the root .gn (setting them now produces unused-argument errors). (c244b2d) (5bc3dc4)
    Build
  • Toolchain/build-infra updates: use_reclient/--no-reclient is replaced by use_remoteexec/--no-remoteexec (--no-reclient kept as a deprecated alias), and build scripts ship a PGO'd GraalVM native-image javac-graalvm producing byte-identical output with roughly 6× faster chrome_java compiles. (25209d4) (c2a6562)
    BuildInfra

2026-10-22

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-22

Overview

Summary of 1032 commits processed on the main branch for October 22, 2026, with 833 relevant changes targeting Windows and macOS embedders. Spanning from (b7b54b5) to (a550a6f).

Core Embedder & Architecture

  • ⚠️content::DocumentService now inherits from base::SelfDeleting, eliminating direct manual delete this patterns and requiring a base::SelfDeletingPassKey in constructors with MakeSelfDeleting instantiation. (1740410)
  • Removed legacy max mapping size, message number, and shared memory size limits from mojo::core::Configuration as modern mojo-ipcz no longer enforces these limits. (b986854)
  • Added Rust bindings for url::Origin (scheme and serialize methods) and GURL, facilitating safe migration of core child process security checks. (332f889) (54bdb3f) (50c0c95)

Security & Data Protection

  • Clipboard operations now enforce strict origin-cleanliness checks before exporting bitmaps or data URLs, disabling copy commands on tainted cross-origin canvases. (6778fee) (dedf2af)
  • Added explicit browser process validation to DOMStorageContextWrapper namespace and storage area bindings, dropping invalid messages from compromised renderers. (02dc3d4)
  • Expanded File System Access API blocklists to prevent write access to sensitive system paths like .git configurations and shell startup files. (d6f2c70)
  • Hardened CRX extension unpacking with UnzipFilesystemImpl, restricting file opens to create-only mode and purging existing targets before writing manifests or hashes. (7a0c3ee)

Browser UI & Desktop Experience

  • Restricted Most Recently Used (MRU) tab switching via Ctrl+Tab strictly to the currently focused browser window's TabStripModel, eliminating cross-monitor focus jumps. (6d33681)
  • Enabled LensSidePanelUnification and ContextualTasksSidePanel by default across desktop platforms to streamline side panel task coordination. (4061337)
  • Introduced dedicated devtools://devtools-remote host for remote DevTools frontends to isolate origin-scoped storage from bundled application files. (9012c26)

Networking & Media

  • Added a memory-safe Rust implementation of HttpChunkedDecoder under net/http/ behind the kRustHttpChunkedDecoder feature flag. (ac8c74c)
  • Integrated MediaFoundation video capture on Windows to stream frames through shared-image pools instead of raw DXGI GpuMemoryBuffer handles. (3e5db22) (9ab4a36)
  • Enforced requirement that web-facing Dawn OpenGL backends must use Chrome's ANGLE pipeline to guarantee driver workarounds. (a3e21e5)

Performance & Base Utilities

  • Migrated mojo::InterfaceEndpointClient internal lookup maps from std::map to absl::flat_hash_map to reduce query overhead. (6c1a689)
  • Gated base::Lock and thread checking ownership tracking on EXPENSIVE_DCHECKS_ARE_ON, improving CPU performance in standard test builds. (5683154)
  • Cached gpu::CollectDawnInfo() results per GPU process lifetime to eliminate multi-second hangs when repeatedly loading chrome://gpu. (2ffdf56)

2026-10-21

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-21

Overview

On 2026-10-21, the Chromium main branch received 899 commits, of which 741 were relevant to embedders and browser developers (first commit: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(8fe8d65), last commit: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(c83f6c5)). This was a heavy day for API removals: the Shared Storage teardown, Top-Level Storage Access cookie plumbing, First-Party Sets internals, GCM account-mapping interfaces, and the legacy DOM distiller were all deleted from stable public surfaces. Embedders should also review the declarativeNetRequest ruleset format bump, the chrome.debugger CDP restriction, the base::FeatureList callback signature change, and the ContentBrowserClient child-module/sandbox API rework.

⚠️ Breaking Changes — Public API Removals

  • ⚠️Shared Storage API teardown: public ContentBrowserClient hooks OnSharedStorageWorkletHostCreated() and OnSharedStorageSelectURLCalled() deleted; BrowsingDataModel::StorageType::kSharedStorage and kSharedStoragePath removed; SharedStorageBudgetMetadata removed from exported FencedFrameConfig structs. Embedders overriding these methods or switching exhaustively on StorageType will fail to compile. (0289254) (e3e3e05) (a431c50)
    PrivacyStorageBrowser
  • ⚠️Top-Level Storage Access cookie plumbing removed: net::CookieSettingOverride::kTopLevelStorageAccessGrantEligible, CookieInclusionStatus::ExemptionReason::kTopLevelStorageAccess, and the kAllowByTopLevelStorageAccess mechanism deleted from net/cookies, services/network mojom, and CookieSettingsBase. Custom cookie-settings implementations will break. (75b7b36)
    NetworkStorageSecurity
  • ⚠️First-Party Sets / Related Website Sets internals removed (~8,600 lines): public header content/public/browser/first_party_sets_handler.h deleted, IsFirstPartySetsEnabled()/WillProvidePublicFirstPartySets() removed from ContentBrowserClient, component installer dropped, and RWS-decided Storage Access grants now unconditionally deleted on startup. (845d377)
    NetworkPrivacyBrowser
  • ⚠️GCM account-mapping/token plumbing removed: GCMClient loses AccountTokenInfo, SetAccountTokens(), UpdateAccountMapping(), RemoveAccountMapping(), SetLastTokenFetchTime(); GCMDriver loses the same plus GetLastTokenFetchTime(); GCMClient::Delegate::OnGCMReady() signature changed to no arguments. Legacy LevelDB entries silently ignored. (ff15f22)
    SyncBase
  • ⚠️base::FeatureList runtime-mutable feature callback signature change: OnRuntimeMutableFeatureStateChangedCallback now receives bool old_is_enabled, bool new_is_enabled instead of OverrideState. New additive IsFeatureEnabledForOverrideState() method. (96102b3)
    Base
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient child-module/sandbox API rework (Windows): ChildModule struct and GetChildModule() removed; PreSpawnChild() signature changed; GetChildProcessPath() now takes content::ChildProcessId. Embedders must migrate to the new GetRendererSandboxPolicyExtension(render_process_id) virtual. (5860166)
    SecurityWindowsBrowser
  • ⚠️Widget::InitParams::force_software_compositing removed along with ui::Compositor::force_software_compositor() and the WindowTreeHost::CreateCompositor() parameter; FrameSinkManager mojom updated. Embedders forcing software compositing for specific widgets must rely on global fallback policy. (0435c36)
    UICompositor
  • ⚠️Legacy DOM distiller engine dropped: DistillerOptions loses its proto::DomDistillerOptions constructor; GetDistillerScriptWithOptions() removed from extraction_utils.h. Migrate to ReadabilityOptions / GetReadabilityDistillerScript(). (50ac38b)
    BrowserStorage
  • ⚠️WebSharedWorker::CreateAndStart() / StartWorkerContext() gain a required network::PermissionsPolicyFeaturesBitset parameter (permissions-policy plumbing for shared workers); new PermissionsPolicy::CreateFromInheritedPolicy() added to //network. (1c9716f)
    ServiceWorkerNetwork

Extensions & Extension APIs

  • ⚠️declarativeNetRequest host-permission enforcement for response header values: rules matching on response header values/excludedValues now require host permissions; non-host-permission matching is restricted to a CORS-safelisted allowlist. Indexed ruleset format version bumps 36 → 37 (rulesets must be re-serialized); rules requiring host permissions are skipped rather than masked. Extension ad-blockers relying on header-value matching without broad host permissions will silently change behavior. (22a2af9)
    ExtensionsNetworkSecurity
  • ⚠️chrome.debugger CDP attach restricted: Target.attachToTarget/Target.autoAttachRelated are now blocked from reaching restricted WebUI <webview> guest targets and their workers. Extensions relying on CDP auto-attach into WebUI guests will silently lose access. (a40d678)
    ExtensionsDevToolsSecurity
  • Extensions security fix: experimentalAiData API can no longer read incognito tab data via getAiData/getTextSurroundingSelection (include_incognito removed from GetTabById paths). (f264cf7)
    ExtensionsPrivacy
  • ImageWriter zstd (.zst) extraction moved out of the browser process into the sandboxed FileUtilService utility process (Rule of 2); new Mojo interfaces in chrome/services/file_util. (5550975)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Component extension installer generalized: ComponentExtensionInstallerPolicy refactored into a reusable config-driven policy; stale staged component extensions are now cleared when ComponentInstaller::Register() finds no valid installation (fixes chrome://newtab startup breakage). NTP component extension now registered via the installer with a real WebUI NTP page. (10bf8e6) (31b52e7) (51602f3) (cd16267)
    ExtensionsUpdaterBrowser
  • Revert of the flag-gated runtime.getDocumentId() extension API (and RenderFrameHost::GetDocumentToken() exposure) due to test failures — restores prior stable behavior. (cf2a92f)
    ExtensionsDevTools

Networking & Cookies

  • Device Bound Sessions (DBSC): federated registration requests now block all redirects to prevent JWT leakage to undeclared origins. Adds URLFetcher::SetShouldFollowRedirectCallback(), new SessionError::kFederatedRegistrationRedirected, and DevTools protocol exposure. (04e9a20)
    NetworkSecurity
  • DevTools 'Open in new tab' navigations now attributed to the inspected page with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site and no SameSite=Strict cookies, closing a CSRF-bypass vector via console/Network panel. (d59f8fb)
    DevToolsSecurityNavigation
  • Security hardening of CreateNewWindowParams: non-empty referrer URLs must be hosted by the initiating renderer process or the renderer is terminated (RFH_CREATE_NEW_WINDOW_INVALID_REFERRER). Only affects misbehaving renderers. (fc98b05)
    SecurityNavigation
  • DOM Storage default fallback now prefers an existing backing store or LevelDB, preventing data loss if the SQLite experiment ends. (dd898c9)
    Storage
  • Windows: WGC window-capturer now falls back to the Cropping window capturer when WGC fails (kill switch kWebRtcWgcWindowCroppingFallback). (f5e8707)
    WebRTCWindows
  • SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets shipped to stable (sourceAddress on MulticastController.joinGroup()/leaveGroup()); Isolated Web Apps only. (8774e07)
    Network

Security & Privacy

  • DevToolsUI privilege-escalation fix: GetTrustPolicy() returns kTrusted only for trusted local frontends; sticky untrusted-opener taint persists across DevToolsUIBindings instances. Previously remote-frontend popups could obtain local DevToolsFrontendHost bindings. (eb15651)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • DevTools blocked for TopChromeWebUIProfile (shared top-chrome WebUI renderer), preventing cross-profile data exposure; still permitted with kDebugTopChromeWebUI. (5d99976)
    DevToolsSecurityProfiles
  • macOS renderer seatbelt profile now restricts process-info-pidinfo to the renderer's own process; unrestricted access behind default-disabled killswitch MacSandboxAllowRendererPidinfo. (e24ae5a)
    SecuritymacOS
  • PWA launch-params security fix: LaunchParams::set_app_id() clears file handles when the app_id is relabeled, preventing cross-app file-handle leaks across redirects; out-of-scope launches silently dropped. (e41efb6)
    SecurityBrowser
  • Auto Picture-in-Picture restricted to the primary main frame — subframes can no longer trigger auto-PiP. (9e42f02)
    MediaSecurity
  • Fixes window.alwaysOnTopPopup state after window.open(): browser-verified values are no longer overwritten by unverified renderer requests. (5fd3bdd)
    SecurityBrowser
  • Windows: wallpaper search background writes go through temp file + rename to prevent symlink-based redirection of base::WriteFile(). (20d97d1)
    SecurityWindowsThemes
  • Windows crypto: RSA attestation identity keys now created through the Platform Crypto Provider (NCryptCreatePersistedKey) instead of raw TPM2_Create; failures surface as provider HRESULTs. (534a3a6)
    CryptoWindowsEnterprise
  • crypto::kex::X25519() made fallible (returns [[nodiscard]] bool) to handle small-order peer points producing all-zero shared secrets. (df5b66f)
    CryptoBase

Browser UI (Windows/macOS)

  • Windows 11 Direct Launch: new DirectLaunchManager registers with the shell's direct-launch API so http/https URI and Start-menu tile launches go straight to the running browser; disabled by default (DirectLaunchManager feature). (250f6ed) (1f66ffb)
    WindowsBrowser
  • Windows Background Mode fix: StartupLaunchManager 60-second lock delay fixed; registry auto-launch entries only removed on actual profile deletion, not clean exits. (a4fe27b)
    WindowsProfiles
  • macOS: main browser executable switched to the Apéritif entry point (chrome_exe_main_mac.c); libaperitif load-time linked with strict link-order verification. Build/packaging-level change for Mac embedders. (0a8aa1d)
    macOSBuild
  • macOS notifications: phantom notificationclose events (with by_user = true) on delivery failure or same-tag replacement fixed, restoring broken subsequent clicks. (6102c3c)
    NotificationsmacOS
  • macOS: stops archiving NSToolbarFullScreenWindow in restorable state, fixing NSInvalidUnarchiveOperationException crashes on fullscreen window restore. (4614eae)
    macOSUI
  • New 'Page Colors' control in chrome://settings/accessibility for forced-colors themes independent of OS High Contrast; behind disabled-by-default page-colors-settings flag. (88299f3)
    UIAccessibilityThemes
  • Windows High Contrast (forced-colors) styles added to cr-searchbox compose button and suggestion states. (f6b9fef)
    UIAccessibilityWindows
  • Tab strip refactors: TabContainerImpl collapsed into TabContainer; focus-mode API migrated to EnterFocusMode/ExitFocusMode; collapsed groups expand on range selection; Shift+Arrow selection preserves pane focus. (6eb8428) (12e5dde) (ce8a45b) (3a34914)
    TabsUI
  • Organizer panel improvements: context menu removed, media tabs pinned to top, keyboard arrow navigation via KeyArrowNavigationService, luminance-based light/dark color tokens with new ChromeColorId entries. (8b0d002) (dc88ebf) (dd3db2f) (7f17993)
    TabsUIThemes
  • FedCM ambient login: when all accounts would sign up rather than sign in, only the location-bar chip is shown. New additive virtual PermissionRequest::ShouldBubbleStartOpen() — embedders subclassing PermissionRequest should review. (62f2e40)
    UIPrivacy
  • WebUI omnibox: Ctrl+L/Cmd+L now un-elides the full URL; OmniboxPopupView::OnFocus() gained a show_full_url parameter. (5218bfb)
    UIBrowser
  • Fullscreen bubble fix: re-show-on-interaction logic now gated on tab-initiated fullscreen only, so browser/extension-initiated fullscreen no longer re-shows the exit instruction. (40354f5)
    UIBrowser
  • DeprecatedLayoutImmediately() now requires a Passkey parameter and is blocked from non-friend classes; TrackedElementWebUI offsets subframe-relative coordinates for OOP iframe/extension subframes. (b5cc6f0) (b3934b1)
    UIBrowser

Base, Storage & Core Libraries

  • ui::TreeModel/TreeModelNode become concrete classes absorbing hierarchy storage from TreeNodeModel<T>. Backward-compatible today, but the commit announces the future deletion of TreeNodeModel/TreeNode — embedders using ui::TreeNodeModel should plan migration. (5e2b824)
    UIBase
  • Blob storage hardening: BlobStorageContext now passes scoped_refptr<BlobEntry> instead of raw pointers, fixing a broad class of use-after-free bugs. (136b3f9)
    StorageBase
  • base/uuid.h forward-declares uint128 instead of including it (~94 MiB compiler input saved); downstream code relying on transitive includes may need adjustments. (2e41c49)
    Base
  • PartitionAlloc: PA_NOINLINE on LeakySingleton::GetSlowPath() (0.4–1.7% malloc throughput gain); new purge-headroom-percent SchedulerLoopQuarantine option; partition cookies gated on enable_expensive_dchecks for dcheck builds (~4% browser_tests CPU savings). (f220ed1) (fcd1596) (d22ad37)
    PerformanceBase
  • Sync hardening: DataTypeStoreImpl now CHECKs IsRealDataType() to prevent empty LevelDB key-prefix collisions; keystore_decryptor_token no longer required in keystore Nigori specifics; obsolete kSyncEncryptionBootstrapToken pref removed. (16593cd) (b9cc457) (76c5d27)
    SyncStorage
  • Windows sign-in: signin_util_win drops the legacy pre-UNO path; GCPW/Credential Provider sign-in always operates at ConsentLevel::kSignin with the History Sync opt-in flow. (0495ecc)
    WindowsProfilesSync
  • Variations: runtime-mutable seed processing delayed until MetricsService can rotate the UMA log; seed serial number synchronized with the loaded seed, fixing kFailedDeltaApply/kFailedDeltaStore after unclean shutdown. Embedders with custom VariationsServiceClient implementations should review. (3dab39e) (754669d)
    InfraBase

DevTools & Automation

  • ChromeDriver now strictly validates --allowed-origins: rejects Origin: null and empty hosts unless * is allowlisted; scheme-less host:port entries parsed as http:// with full validation. Automation setups relying on lax matching must update configs. (39b0b60)
    DevToolsTestingSecurity
  • Additive DevTools API: DevToolsAgentHostClient::GetPeerMetadata() (transport type + peer net::IPEndPoint) with a default implementation; child sessions propagate root transport metadata. Non-breaking. (dabb873)
    DevTools
  • chromium-bidi: excludes CDP round-trip latency from multi-click timing in input.performActions, fixing suppressed dblclick events under slow CDP. (c15c7c8)
    DevToolsTesting
  • WebMCP: fixes Latin-1 (U+0080–U+00FF) character handling in CDP tool schemas/outputs via StringUtf8Adaptor before CBOR conversion. (3521427)
    DevToolsAI

Enterprise, Policy & Payments

  • Expired kProfileSignalsReportingEnabled feature removed; profile security-signals reporting is now unconditional with hardcoded 4-hour upload cadence and always-on cookie-change triggering. Enterprise admins lose field-trial param tuning. (4c350a7)
    EnterprisePolicyPrivacy
  • Enterprise Copy Trigger: new ToastId::kEnterpriseCopyFailClosed distinguishes failed scans from real DLP block verdicts. browser_events.proto gains ProcessNode/ExternalProcessInfo for CDP-actor attribution (additive). (807f138) (3174c2d)
    EnterprisePolicy

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-20

Overview

On 2026-10-20, the Chromium main branch received 936 commits, of which 739 were relevant to embedders building on Chromium for Windows and macOS (ChromeOS/Ash, iOS, Android, Linux, and Blink/V8 rendering changes excluded). The day featured several confirmed breaking changes to stable public APIs — including the removal of the WindowOpenDisposition C++ enum, the treat-as-public-address CSP directive, ProcessMap::Contains(int), and signature changes to ContentBrowserClient::SelectClientCertificate(), SharedImageInterface::CopyToGpuMemoryBuffer(), AutofillClient, and extensions permission classes — plus a significant macOS Keychain encryption behavior change for non-default user data directories. First commit: (7769692). Last commit: (bcc3463).

BREAKING CHANGES

  • ⚠️Removal of the native C++ WindowOpenDisposition enum from ui/base — replaced by a temporary alias to the mojo-generated ui::mojom::WindowOpenDisposition. Embedders referencing the type must now depend on //ui/base/mojom and include window_open_disposition.mojom-forward.h. Signatures migrated across chrome/browser/ui, ash_web_view.h, and mock_tab_restore_service.h. (84278ec)
    UIBrowserExtensions
  • ⚠️Complete removal of the treat-as-public-address CSP directive from the Local Network Access implementation — the CSPDirectiveName::TreatAsPublicAddress enum value, mojom field, and exported ShouldTreatAsPublicAddress() function are all deleted. Tooling parsing CSP headers will see the directive silently ignored; replacement is the ip-address-space-override mechanism. (62b4de5)
    NetworkSecurityNavigation
  • ⚠️macOS Keychain encryption key behavior change — KeychainKeyProvider now derives a different key (alternate key tag + PBKDF2 salt) when running with a non-default user data directory, making encrypted data (cookies, passwords) incompatible between default and custom data dirs. Directly impacts automation harnesses and embedders launching macOS Chrome with --user-data-dir. (c7ee20c)
    SecuritymacOSCrypto
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::SelectClientCertificate() signature change — now takes content::ChildProcessId instead of int process_id. All embedders overriding this method must update; browser-process-initiated requests now report a null ChildProcessId instead of kBrowserProcessId (0). (d49133c)
    NavigationSSLSecurity
  • ⚠️extensions::ProcessMap::Contains(int) removed — the interface now exclusively accepts content::ChildProcessId. Embedder code calling Contains() with raw ints (e.g., via RenderProcessHost::GetDeprecatedID()) will fail to compile and must migrate to GetID(). (2d3c9a0)
    ExtensionsNavigation
  • ⚠️chrome.runtime.onExtensionLoaded event semantics changed — previousVersion is now populated for reason "enable" (set to the current version), and when an install/update coincides with an enable, only the higher-precedence event fires. Extensions relying on receiving both events or on previousVersion being absent for "enable" need updates. (958dc38)
    Extensions
  • ⚠️SharedImageInterface::CopyToGpuMemoryBuffer() signature change — first parameter changed from (const SyncToken&, const Mailbox&) to (std::vector<SyncToken>, const Mailbox&), propagated through ClientSharedImageInterface and SharedImageInterfaceProxy. Embedders with custom media/video-frame integrations must update. (e0408f4)
    GPUMedia
  • ⚠️AutofillClient::SupportsDeviceReauth() virtual removed from the public interface and replaced by free function autofill::SupportsDeviceReauth(const AutofillClient&) in the new device_reauth_util.{h,cc}. Embedders implementing AutofillClient must remove overrides; TestAutofillClient::set_supports_device_reauth() also removed. (8658d68)
    AutofillPasswordManager
  • ⚠️Extensions permission API signature changes — ManifestPermission::ToValue() now returns base::Value (was std::unique_ptr<base::Value>); APIPermission::ToValue() now returns std::optional<base::Value>. Embedders with custom ManifestPermission/APIPermission implementations must update. (a8d6ae0)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • ⚠️New ContentBrowserClient::IsContentSchemeURLNavigationAllowed() hook added and content:// navigations are now blocked by default (net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT) unless the embedder opts out via features::kBlockContentUriNavigationByDefault. Embedders overriding ContentBrowserClient must implement the new hook. (50dd531)
    NavigationSecurityBrowser
  • views::ViewShadow renamed to views::ViewDecoration across ui/views/ and chrome/ — a pure rename with minor source-compat impact for out-of-tree code using the old class name. (63a7b8d)
    UIThemes
  • TreeModel::GetIcons()/GetIconIndex() public virtuals removed from ui/base/models/tree_model.h — dead code with default implementations; only affects embedders overriding them. (311c014)
    UIBase
  • VirtualUnexportableKeyProvider and the metrics-only getter removed from crypto/unexportable_key.h (~600 lines, Windows Credential Guard implementation removed). Low practical impact as the provider was never used for key operations. (2a9a149)
    CryptoSecurityWindows

Networking & Security

  • Mojo IPC hardening on macOS — named Mach channels now support server authentication: NamedPlatformChannel::Options gains a server_process_requirement knob and ChannelMac queues outbound messages until the peer's audit token is validated (fail-closed). Defends against bootstrap-name squatting. (13391ee)
    SecuritymacOSNetwork
  • Windows TPM crypto fix — stops setting NCRYPT_PCP_RSA_SCHEME_HASH_ALG_PROPERTY on new TPM RSA keys, restoring TPM key creation on TPM 1.2 machines (broken since M152). (674e045)
    CryptoWindowsSecurity
  • Compromised eMudhra intermediates added to the certificate blocklist (net/cert/cert_verify_proc_blocklist.inc). (da63b94)
    SSLSecurity

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-19

Overview

Daily summary of Chromium development on 2026-10-19 focusing on Windows and macOS desktop platforms, covering 891 total commits with 746 relevant changes ranging from commit (8763631) to (74d5624).

Browser UI & Window Management

  • Fixed a heap-use-after-free crash during macOS profile switching by explicitly resetting the menu delegate and clearing bridge pointers in HistoryMenuBridge. (4c0372d)
    BrowserUImacOS
  • Enabled Round 3 Phase 1 default browser prompt surfaces by default on Windows 11 and newer platforms. (b6c9c5f)
    BrowserUIWindows
  • Updated NonClientView and WidgetDelegate overlay view ownership semantics from raw pointers to explicit unique_ptr transfers to prevent memory leaks. (924689b)
    BrowserUI
  • Excluded non-tabbed browser windows like standalone PWAs from global Ctrl+Tab MRU tab switching. (d967ec5)
    BrowserTabsUI

Security, Privacy & Extensions

  • Enforced strict download host verification against declared web extents during self-hosted app CRX installations to prevent scope bypasses. (b5c4b39)
    ExtensionsSecurityPrivacy
  • Passed extension initiator context into Safe Browsing download paths and deep-scanning requests for accurate malware and DLP attribution. (3b06f60)
    ExtensionsSecurityDownloads
  • Masked PII such as Gaia IDs and email addresses by default within chrome://signin-internals. (e4255bc)
    PrivacyBrowserSecurity
  • Validated URL chains against supervised user policies directly inside DownloadTargetDeterminer to block sandbox and redirect bypasses. (989f51e)
    SecurityDownloadsEnterprise

Networking, Performance & Core Architecture

  • Added the kPrewarmCryptbase feature on Windows to pre-load and pin cryptbase.dll on a background thread during Network Service startup. (7e6a6c7)
    NetworkPerformanceWindows
  • Enhanced network service UDP socket safety by strictly validating multicast group addresses from Mojo IPC and returning explicit error codes instead of crashing. (a9a57df) (a559af3)
    NetworkSecurity
  • Improved QUIC connection handling and Happy Eyeballs support by alternating address families on fast connection failures according to RFC 8305. (45d6ce5)
    NetworkPerformance
  • Wrapped incoming CacheStorage Mojo callbacks with default invocation handlers to prevent request hangs when data buckets are force-closed. (6613f89) (d24152b)

Overview

Out of 669 commits on 2026-10-12 (main branch), 492 were relevant to Chromium-based projects. The day was dominated by AI/Actor/Glic feature work, security hardening, and large-scale build/test cleanup. Two confirmed breaking changes require embedder action: removal of the default scope argument from ActionManager::FindAction() ((89aa9ea)) and the ContentBrowserClient child-module API change ((b73ceff)). Breaking Changes
