GetChildModuleVersion() is replaced by GetChildModule() returning a new ChildModule struct (version + path), and PreSpawnChild() now takes base::optional_ref<const ChildModule>. ChildModuleManager consolidated to GetLatestModule(). Windows embedders overriding these sandbox/dynamic-patching hooks must update their implementations. (b73ceff)

    Media
  • AVX requirement for on-device speech recognition restored to macOS-x86_64 only (Windows falls back as before); ChromeScreenAI adds SSE4.2 device-compatibility checks during library verification to prevent SIGILL crashes on incompatible CPUs. (75f9cd2) (f567349)
    MediamacOSWindows

Extensions

  • SHA-256 extension-ID hashes appended alongside legacy SHA-1 in _api_features.json/_permission_features.json (app.runtime, feedbackPrivate, fileSystem, loginState, management, etc.) as part of the HashedExtensionId migration. Purely additive. (1b161eb) (eb27070)
    Extensions
  • Additive metrics: new ValueCounter::total_count()/distinct_count() accessors and histograms measuring filtered extension event listener duplication (groundwork for a possible per-listener registration change; no behavior change yet). (ef51975)
    Extensions
  • New test-only --allow-webui-test-in-component-extensions switch lets built-in component extensions load chrome://webui-test helpers in browser tests; production behavior unchanged. (704360a)
    ExtensionsTesting
  • chrome.tabs/chrome.windows internals: tabs_internal helpers split into tabs_util and per-API anonymous namespaces — internal code organization, no extension-facing behavior change. (fdf76e1)
    Extensions

Autofill, Passwords & WebAuthn

  • Fixes stuck is_authentication_in_progress_ state when mandatory card re-auth is skipped on devices without authentication support, which previously blocked all subsequent card fills. (0fbc095)
    AutofillPayments
  • PasswordManagerClient gains GetDeviceAuthAvailabilityChecker() and IsReauthBeforeFillingRequired(checker) with default implementations — purely additive; legacy methods retained. (20a2f0b) (ec1ce9e)
    PasswordManager
  • WebAuthn: iCloud Keychain recovery factored into a webauthn::ICloudRecovery helper (reland, no behavior change); 5-minute recency tolerance when deduplicating GPM passkeys vs. passwords (flag-gated); GPM passkey creation_time now uses millisecond precision. (dc6eecc) (7fb2b78) (b53198e)
    PasswordManagermacOS
  • Autofill AI: entity suppressions now cleared on Delete Browsing Data; suppression sync protocol gains creation_time_windows_epoch_micros and ClearAllSuppressions() replaced by range-based ClearSuppressions() (flag-guarded internal API change). AtMemory address results now include company, email, and phone metadata. (077dca1) (1f29529)
    AutofillAI
  • Reverted default-enable of AutofillFixIframeOwnership (staged rollout). (a8aad2a)
    Autofill

Sync, Profiles & Sign-in

  • Removed default-enabled sync feature flags kSyncUseServerDeterminedDeviceName and kSyncSimplifyDeviceNaming, deleting legacy device-naming helpers; device display names now unconditionally use simplified/server-determined APIs. (d990e35) (598c4dd)
    SyncProfiles
  • Desktop first-run variations seed now imported through VariationsSeedStore::ImportInitialSeed() (signature-validated, stored compressed, enables delta/304 fetches), unifying desktop with Android/iOS seed handling; variations crash keys now started centrally in VariationsService::SetUpFieldTrials() (embedder call sites removed). (119e7fb) (d27892a)
    SyncInfra
  • SigninPrefs now retain keyed preferences for accounts with refresh tokens; GAIAInfoUpdateService waits for token loading before pruning. Startup fix-up re-enables Reading List for sync-to-signin users migrated before the migration fix (new EnableReadingListForMigratedUsers feature, disabled by default). (8c6e3e6) (5d93893)
    SyncProfiles
  • Loomnibox (Omnibox Everywhere): enables unbounded profile picker menu by default with 96×96 avatars and localized "Switch Profile"; pasted/dropped files no longer open AI Mode when it is unavailable, falling back to normal paste behavior. (8c5b629) (bed34b0)
    ProfilesUI

DevTools & Testing Tools

  • Deprecates IO.resolveBlob in the CDP (deprecation, not removal — watch item for CDP tooling). New Page.setInputVisualization CDP method visualizes clicks in screencasts, useful for automation tooling like Puppeteer. (9382e67) (0b268b1)
    DevTools
  • DevTools embedder dispatcher now enforces local-frontend restrictions: remote frontends (devtools://devtools/remote/) get empty settings and cannot persist preferences or access account info — security hardening with a behavioral change for remote-frontend embedders. (200411e)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • Reland: protocol notifications are no longer flushed while V8 execution is interrupted (DevToolsSession::FlushProtocolNotifications early-returns when interrupting), preventing Blink re-entry inside interrupted isolates. Fixes crashes 570938760/558236920/332901804; CDP clients may observe deferred notification timing. (a6633b9)
    DevToolsV8
  • ChromeDriver now reports userAgent in New Session capabilities (WebDriver capability response change); chromium-bidi accessibility locator results capped by maxNodeCount; temporal input hosts now blur directly after WebDriver Clear. (64da1c6) (8dfea6f) (ed373c6)
    TestingDevTools
  • Native macOS Cocoa drag-and-drop simulation for browser tests; exposes content::IsDragCanceledForTesting/CleanupDragStateForTesting in content/public/test (test-only additions). (f51cf84)
    TestingmacOS
  • WebMCP: tools now identified by unique unguessable tool_id for unregistration, fixing a race where unregistering by name could remove a different tool. Mojom field is optional for now; embedders will be migrated in follow-ups. (0e2d988)
    AITesting

Base, UI Framework & Code Health

  • ImportantFileWriter: when a replace operation fails and the target file is lost, the temp file is now preserved as a recovery candidate instead of deleted — improves data durability for all users. (a6c86ee)
    BaseStorage
  • Mojo Broker trimmed to shared-memory allocation only: deletes Windows broker paths (broker_win.cc), SendChannel/SendNamedChannel, and process_error_callback.h. Wire format unchanged; relevant only to deep embedders. (dd1453c)
    BaseWindows
  • MenuItemView: controller access restricted to root items; set_controller() renamed to SetController() with CHECKs and death tests — embedders misusing non-root menu item controllers will now hit CHECK failures. Also fixes dangling-pointer crash when non-root menu items are destroyed (Mac MenuClosureAnimationMac crash). (41c3b2a) (997d4dd)
    UImacOS
  • IWYU: url/gurl.h no longer transitively includes url/url_canon_stdstring.h — out-of-tree embedders relying on that transitive include must add it explicitly. GURL Get*() → string_view accessors migration across chrome/browser/ui/webui. (a9a1cfc) (8908c5e)
    BaseBrowser
  • Iterator modernization (std::bidirectional_iterator) for LinkedHashSet, AXNode::ChildIterator, TabCollection::TabIterator, and ImplementationList::Iterator; call sites moved from base::Reversed to std::views::reverse. cbor: adds ValueView non-owning type; Writer::Write/WriteDiagnostic now take ValueView (backward-compatible via implicit conversion). (6440c9e) (7c20cda)
    BaseAccessibility
  • Accessibility: Views AX actions are now only dispatched to nodes present in the client tree (new AXTreeSourceViews::GetActionTarget()), preventing actions on pruned/invisible-subtree nodes. (7ac1676)
    AccessibilityUI
  • macOS GPU: removes remaining dual-GPU (automatic graphics switching) handling from GpuInit2, deleting ~1,400 lines including dual-GPU integration tests. Internal simplification, no public API change. (2fa051e)
    GPUmacOS
  • Large coordinated migration (Bug 540709814) moves WebContentsUserData helper attachment out of TabHelpers::AttachTabHelpers into the new TabFeatures class (SubresourceFilter, Translate, PageSpecificContentSettings, FaviconDriver, History, InstallableManager, OptimizationGuide, SafeBrowsing AsyncCheckTracker, PageLoadMetrics). Embedders patching tab_helpers.cc will see conflicts. (875cc29) (5b4cbd9) (c54bf53) (3e5b9b4) (934d2d9) (f721d11) (4921412) (be2fb39) (d024dd1) (3b37ab9)
    BrowserNavigation
  • Build hygiene: multi-part removal of redundant //chrome/browser:browser_public_dependencies from ~80 BUILD.gn files; wexit_time_destructors configs removed (warning enabled by default); GN dependency cleanups in chrome/test/BUILD.gn. (3390641) (df5d45f) (9840e69) (bb8dc53) (256f759)
    Build
  • Shared memory span migration: SharedMemoryMapping::memory() callers migrated to GetMemoryAs<T>()/span APIs across gamepad, sensor, media, and GPU code (type-safety migration). (133929c)
